verses.textZh: 所罗门的歌，是歌中之歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门的歌，是歌中之歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门的歌，是歌中的雅歌。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon’s Song of Songs. verses.textEnEsv: The Song of Songs, which is Solomon’s. She#1:2 The translators have added speaker identifications based on the gender and number of the Hebrew words
verses.textEnNkjv: The song of songs, which is Solomon’s. The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: This is Solomon’s song of songs, more wonderful than any other. Young Woman#1:1 The headings identifying the speakers are not in the original text, though the Hebrew usually gives clues by means of the gender of the person speaking.
verses.textEnNasb: The Song of Songs, which is Solomon’s. # 1:2 The speaker identifications are not from the Hebrew text nor the Septuagint, but reflect an ancient tradition which appears in some manuscripts. The Bride
verses.textEn: Solomon’s Song of Songs. verses.textZh: 愿他用口中的热吻与我亲嘴， 因为你的热爱比酒更美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿他用口中的热吻与我亲嘴， 因为你的热爱比酒更美。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿他用口与我亲嘴； 因你的爱情比酒更美。
verses.textEnNiv: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth— for your love is more delightful than wine.
verses.textEnEsv: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth! For your love is better than wine;
verses.textEnNkjv: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth— For your love is better than wine.
verses.textEnNlt: Kiss me and kiss me again, for your love is sweeter than wine.
verses.textEnNasb: "May he kiss me with the kisses of his mouth! For your love is sweeter than wine.
verses.textEn: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth— for your love is more delightful than wine.

verses.textZh: 你的膏油香气芬芳； 你的名字如同倒出来的膏油； 所以众童女都爱你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的膏油香气芬芳； 你的名字如同倒出来的膏油； 所以众童女都爱你。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的膏油馨香； 你的名如同倒出来的香膏， 所以众童女都爱你。
verses.textEnNiv: Pleasing is the fragrance of your perfumes; your name is like perfume poured out. No wonder the young women love you!
verses.textEnEsv: your anointing oils are fragrant; your name is oil poured out; therefore virgins love you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of the fragrance of your good ointments, Your name is ointment poured forth; Therefore the virgins love you.
verses.textEnNlt: How pleasing is your fragrance; your name is like the spreading fragrance of scented oils. No wonder all the young women love you!
verses.textEnNasb: "Your oils have a pleasing fragrance, Your name is like purified oil; Therefore the young women love you.
verses.textEn: Pleasing is the fragrance of your perfumes; your name is like perfume poured out. No wonder the young women love you!

verses.textZh: 愿你吸引我，我们必快跑跟随你。 王领我进入他的内室。 王啊！我们要因你欢喜快乐； 我们要提说你的爱，胜过提说美酒； 她们爱你是合理的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 愿你吸引我，我们必快跑跟随你。 王领我进入他的内室。 王啊！我们要因你欢喜快乐； 我们要提说你的爱，胜过提说美酒； 她们爱你是合理的。
verses.textZhCuv: 愿你吸引我，我们就快跑跟随你。 王带我进了内室， 我们必因你欢喜快乐。 我们要称赞你的爱情， 胜似称赞美酒。 他们爱你是理所当然的。
verses.textEnNiv: Take me away with you—let us hurry! Let the king bring me into his chambers. Friends We rejoice and delight in you ; we will praise your love more than wine. She How right they are to adore you!
verses.textEnEsv: Draw me after you; let us run. The king has brought me into his chambers. Others We will exult and rejoice in you; we will extol your love more than wine; rightly do they love you. She
verses.textEnNkjv: Draw me away! The Daughters of Jerusalem We will run after you. The Shulamite The king has brought me into his chambers. The Daughters of Jerusalem We will be glad and rejoice in you. We will remember your love more than wine. The Shulamite Rightly do they love you.
verses.textEnNlt: Take me with you; come, let’s run! The king has brought me into his bedroom. Young Women of Jerusalem How happy we are for you, O king. We praise your love even more than wine. Young Woman How right they are to adore you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Draw me after you and let’s run together! The king has brought me into his chambers." The Chorus "We will rejoice in you and be joyful; We will praise your love more than wine. Rightly do they love you." The Bride
verses.textEn: Take me away with you—let us hurry! Let the king bring me into his chambers. Friends We rejoice and delight in you ; we will praise your love more than wine. She How right they are to adore you!

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！ 我虽然黑，却是秀美， 如同基达的帐棚， 好象所罗门的幔幕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！ 我虽然黑，却是秀美， 如同基达的帐棚， 好象所罗门的幔幕。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊， 我虽然黑，却是秀美， 如同基达的帐棚， 好像所罗门的幔子。
verses.textEnNiv: Dark am I, yet lovely, daughters of Jerusalem, dark like the tents of Kedar, like the tent curtains of Solomon.
verses.textEnEsv: I am very dark, but lovely, O daughters of Jerusalem, like the tents of Kedar, like the curtains of Solomon.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am dark, but lovely, O daughters of Jerusalem, Like the tents of Kedar, Like the curtains of Solomon.
verses.textEnNlt: I am dark but beautiful, O women of Jerusalem— dark as the tents of Kedar, dark as the curtains of Solomon’s tents.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am black and beautiful, You daughters of Jerusalem, Like the tents of Kedar, Like the curtains of Solomon.
verses.textEn: Dark am I, yet lovely, daughters of Jerusalem, dark like the tents of Kedar, like the tent curtains of Solomon.

verses.textZh: 你们不要因为我黑，就盯着我， 因为太阳把我晒黑了。 我母亲的儿子生我的气； 他们叫我看守家里的葡萄园， 我自己私人的葡萄园，我却没有看守。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们不要因为我黑，就盯着我， 因为太阳把我晒黑了。 我母亲的儿子生我的气； 他们叫我看守家里的葡萄园， 我自己私人的葡萄园，我却没有看守。
verses.textZhCuv: 不要因日头把我晒黑了就轻看我。 我同母的弟兄向我发怒， 他们使我看守葡萄园； 我自己的葡萄园却没有看守。
verses.textEnNiv: Do not stare at me because I am dark, because I am darkened by the sun. My mother’s sons were angry with me and made me take care of the vineyards; my own vineyard I had to neglect.
verses.textEnEsv: Do not gaze at me because I am dark, because the sun has looked upon me. My mother’s sons were angry with me; they made me keeper of the vineyards, but my own vineyard I have not kept!
verses.textEnNkjv: Do not look upon me, because I am dark, Because the sun has tanned me. My mother’s sons were angry with me; They made me the keeper of the vineyards, But my own vineyard I have not kept. (To Her Beloved)
verses.textEnNlt: Don’t stare at me because I am dark— the sun has darkened my skin. My brothers were angry with me; they forced me to care for their vineyards, so I couldn’t care for myself—my own vineyard.
verses.textEnNasb: "Do not stare at me because I am dark, For the sun has tanned me. My mother’s sons were angry with me; They made me caretaker of the vineyards, But I have not taken care of my own vineyard.
verses.textEn: Do not stare at me because I am dark, because I am darkened by the sun. My mother’s sons were angry with me and made me take care of the vineyards; my own vineyard I had to neglect.

verses.textZh: 我心所爱的啊！求你告诉我， 你在哪里放羊？ 中午你在哪里使羊群躺卧休息。 我为甚么在你众同伴的羊群旁边， 好象蒙着脸的女人呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我心所爱的啊！求你告诉我， 你在哪里放羊？ 中午你在哪里使羊群躺卧休息。 我为甚么在你众同伴的羊群旁边， 好象蒙着脸的女人呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我心所爱的啊，求你告诉我， 你在何处牧羊？ 晌午在何处使羊歇卧？ 我何必在你同伴的羊群旁边 好像蒙着脸的人呢？ 〔新郎〕
verses.textEnNiv: Tell me, you whom I love, where you graze your flock and where you rest your sheep at midday. Why should I be like a veiled woman beside the flocks of your friends? Friends
verses.textEnEsv: Tell me, you whom my soul loves, where you pasture your flock, where you make it lie down at noon; for why should I be like one who veils herself beside the flocks of your companions? He
verses.textEnNkjv: Tell me, O you whom I love, Where you feed yourflock, Where you make it rest at noon. For why should I be as one who veils herself By the flocks of your companions? The Beloved
verses.textEnNlt: Tell me, my love, where are you leading your flock today? Where will you rest your sheep at noon? For why should I wander like a prostitute among your friends and their flocks? Young Man
verses.textEnNasb: "Tell me, you whom my soul loves, Where do you pasture your flock, Where do you have it lie down at noon? For why should I be like one who veils herself Beside the flocks of your companions?"
verses.textEn: Tell me, you whom I love, where you graze your flock and where you rest your sheep at midday. Why should I be like a veiled woman beside the flocks of your friends? Friends

verses.textZh: 你这女子中最美丽的啊！ 你若不知道， 可以出去，跟随羊群的脚踪， 在牧人的帐棚边， 牧放你的山羊羔。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这女子中最美丽的啊！ 你若不知道， 可以出去，跟随羊群的脚踪， 在牧人的帐棚边， 牧放你的山羊羔。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这女子中极美丽的， 你若不知道， 只管跟随羊群的脚踪去， 把你的山羊羔牧放在牧人帐棚的旁边。
verses.textEnNiv: If you do not know, most beautiful of women, follow the tracks of the sheep and graze your young goats by the tents of the shepherds. He
verses.textEnEsv: If you do not know, O most beautiful among women, follow in the tracks of the flock, and pasture your young goats beside the shepherds’ tents.
verses.textEnNkjv: If you do not know, O fairest among women, Follow in the footsteps of the flock, And feed your little goats Beside the shepherds’ tents.
verses.textEnNlt: If you don’t know, O most beautiful woman, follow the trail of my flock, and graze your young goats by the shepherds’ tents.
verses.textEnNasb: "If you yourself do not know, Most beautiful among women, Go out on the trail of the flock, And pasture your young goats By the tents of the shepherds.
verses.textEn: If you do not know, most beautiful of women, follow the tracks of the sheep and graze your young goats by the tents of the shepherds. He

verses.textZh: 我的佳偶啊！我把你 比作套在法老车上的骏马。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的佳偶啊！我把你 比作套在法老车上的骏马。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的佳偶， 我将你比法老车上套的骏马。
verses.textEnNiv: I liken you, my darling, to a mare among Pharaoh’s chariot horses.
verses.textEnEsv: I compare you, my love, to a mare among Pharaoh’s chariots.
verses.textEnNkjv: I have compared you, my love, To my filly among Pharaoh’s chariots.
verses.textEnNlt: You are as exciting, my darling, as a mare among Pharaoh’s stallions.
verses.textEnNasb: " To me, my darling, you are like My mare among the chariots of Pharaoh.
verses.textEn: I liken you, my darling, to a mare among Pharaoh’s chariot horses.

verses.textZh: 你的两腮因耳环显得秀丽； 你的颈项因珠炼显得华美。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的两腮因耳环显得秀丽； 你的颈项因珠炼显得华美。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的两腮因发辫而秀美； 你的颈项因珠串而华丽。
verses.textEnNiv: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.
verses.textEnEsv: Your cheeks are lovely with ornaments, your neck with strings of jewels. Others
verses.textEnNkjv: Your cheeks are lovely with ornaments, Your neck with chains ofgold. The Daughters of Jerusalem
verses.textEnNlt: How lovely are your cheeks; your earrings set them afire! How lovely is your neck, enhanced by a string of jewels.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your cheeks are delightful with jewelry, Your neck with strings of beads." The Chorus
verses.textEn: Your cheeks are beautiful with earrings, your neck with strings of jewels.

verses.textZh: 我们要为你制金耳环， 用银珠点缀。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们要为你制金耳环， 用银珠点缀。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们要为你编上金辫，镶上银钉。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: We will make you earrings of gold, studded with silver. She
verses.textEnEsv: We will make for you ornaments of gold, studded with silver. She
verses.textEnNkjv: We will make you ornaments of gold With studs of silver. The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: We will make for you earrings of gold and beads of silver. Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: "We will make for you jewelry of gold With beads of silver." The Bride
verses.textEn: We will make you earrings of gold, studded with silver. She

verses.textZh: 王正坐席的时候， 我的哪哒香膏散发芬芳的香味，
verses.textZhCnvs: 王正坐席的时候， 我的哪哒香膏散发芬芳的香味，
verses.textZhCuv: 王正坐席的时候， 我的哪哒香膏发出香味。
verses.textEnNiv: While the king was at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.
verses.textEnEsv: While the king was on his couch, my nard gave forth its fragrance.
verses.textEnNkjv: While the king is at his table, My spikenard sends forth its fragrance.
verses.textEnNlt: The king is lying on his couch, enchanted by the fragrance of my perfume.
verses.textEnNasb: "While the king was at his table, My perfume gave forth its fragrance.
verses.textEn: While the king was at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.

verses.textZh: 我以我的良人为一袋没药， 挂在我的胸怀之中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我以我的良人为一袋没药， 挂在我的胸怀之中。
verses.textZhCuv: 我以我的良人为一袋没药， 常在我怀中。
verses.textEnNiv: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh resting between my breasts.
verses.textEnEsv: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh that lies between my breasts.
verses.textEnNkjv: A bundle of myrrh is my beloved to me, That lies all night between my breasts.
verses.textEnNlt: My lover is like a sachet of myrrh lying between my breasts.
verses.textEnNasb: "My beloved is to me a pouch of myrrh Which lies all night between my breasts.
verses.textEn: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh resting between my breasts.

verses.textZh: 我以我的良人为一束凤仙花， 开放在隐．基底的葡萄园里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我以我的良人为一束凤仙花， 开放在隐．基底的葡萄园里。
verses.textZhCuv: 我以我的良人为一棵凤仙花， 在隐‧基底葡萄园中。 〔新郎〕
verses.textEnNiv: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi. He
verses.textEnEsv: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms in the vineyards of Engedi. He
verses.textEnNkjv: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blooms In the vineyards of En Gedi. The Beloved
verses.textEnNlt: He is like a bouquet of sweet henna blossoms from the vineyards of En-gedi. Young Man
verses.textEnNasb: "My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms In the vineyards of Engedi." The Groom
verses.textEn: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms from the vineyards of En Gedi. He

verses.textZh: 我的佳偶啊！你很美丽； 你很美丽。 你的眼好象鸽子的眼睛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的佳偶啊！你很美丽； 你很美丽。 你的眼好象鸽子的眼睛。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的佳偶，你甚美丽！你甚美丽！ 你的眼好像鸽子眼。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: How beautiful you are, my darling! Oh, how beautiful! Your eyes are doves. She
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you are beautiful, my love; behold, you are beautiful; your eyes are doves. She
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, you are fair, my love! Behold, you are fair! You have dove’s eyes. The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: How beautiful you are, my darling, how beautiful! Your eyes are like doves. Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: " How beautiful you are, my darling, How beautiful you are! Your eyes are like doves." The Bride
verses.textEn: How beautiful you are, my darling! Oh, how beautiful! Your eyes are doves. She

verses.textZh: 我的良人，你很英俊， 你很可爱。 我们的床榻是青绿的树木；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良人，你很英俊， 你很可爱。 我们的床榻是青绿的树木；
verses.textZhCuv: 我的良人哪，你甚美丽可爱！ 我们以青草为床榻，
verses.textEnNiv: How handsome you are, my beloved! Oh, how charming! And our bed is verdant. He
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you are beautiful, my beloved, truly delightful. Our couch is green;
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, you are handsome, my beloved! Yes, pleasant! Also our bed is green.
verses.textEnNlt: You are so handsome, my love, pleasing beyond words! The soft grass is our bed;
verses.textEnNasb: " How handsome you are, my beloved, And so delightful! Indeed, our bed is luxuriant!
verses.textEn: How handsome you are, my beloved! Oh, how charming! And our bed is verdant. He

verses.textZh: 我们房屋的栋梁是香柏树， 房屋的椽子是松树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们房屋的栋梁是香柏树， 房屋的椽子是松树。
verses.textZhCuv: 以香柏树为房屋的栋梁， 以松树为椽子。
verses.textEnNiv: The beams of our house are cedars; our rafters are firs.
verses.textEnEsv: the beams of our house are cedar; our rafters are pine.
verses.textEnNkjv: The beams of our houses are cedar, And our rafters of fir.
verses.textEnNlt: fragrant cedar branches are the beams of our house, and pleasant smelling firs are the rafters.
verses.textEnNasb: "The beams of our house are cedars, Our rafters, junipers.
verses.textEn: The beams of our house are cedars; our rafters are firs.

verses.textZh: 我是沙仑平原的水仙花， 是谷中的百合花。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是沙仑平原的水仙花， 是谷中的百合花。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是沙仑的玫瑰花 ， 是谷中的百合花。 〔新郎〕
verses.textEnNiv: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys. He
verses.textEnEsv: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys. He
verses.textEnNkjv: I am the rose of Sharon, And the lily of the valleys. The Beloved
verses.textEnNlt: I am the spring crocus blooming on the Sharon Plain, the lily of the valley. Young Man
verses.textEnNasb: "I am the rose of Sharon, The lily of the valleys." The Groom
verses.textEn: I am a rose of Sharon, a lily of the valleys. He

verses.textZh: 我的佳偶在女子中， 正像荆棘里的百合花。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的佳偶在女子中， 正像荆棘里的百合花。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的佳偶在女子中， 好像百合花在荆棘内。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: Like a lily among thorns is my darling among the young women. She
verses.textEnEsv: As a lily among brambles, so is my love among the young women. She
verses.textEnNkjv: Like a lily among thorns, So is my love among the daughters. The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: Like a lily among thistles is my darling among young women. Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: "Like a lily among the thorns, So is my darling among the young women." The Bride
verses.textEn: Like a lily among thorns is my darling among the young women. She

verses.textZh: 我的良人在男子中， 好象树林里的一棵苹果树； 我欢欢喜喜地坐在它的荫下， 它的果子香甜合我口味。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良人在男子中， 好象树林里的一棵苹果树； 我欢欢喜喜地坐在它的荫下， 它的果子香甜合我口味。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的良人在男子中， 如同苹果树在树林中。 我欢欢喜喜坐在他的荫下， 尝他果子的滋味，觉得甘甜。
verses.textEnNiv: Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest is my beloved among the young men. I delight to sit in his shade, and his fruit is sweet to my taste.
verses.textEnEsv: As an apple tree among the trees of the forest, so is my beloved among the young men. With great delight I sat in his shadow, and his fruit was sweet to my taste.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like an apple tree among the trees of the woods, So is my beloved among the sons. I sat down in his shade with great delight, And his fruit was sweet to my taste. The Shulamite to the Daughters of Jerusalem
verses.textEnNlt: Like the finest apple tree in the orchard is my lover among other young men. I sit in his delightful shade and taste his delicious fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: "Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest, So is my beloved among the young men. In his shade I took great delight and sat down, And his fruit was sweet to my taste.
verses.textEn: Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest is my beloved among the young men. I delight to sit in his shade, and his fruit is sweet to my taste.

verses.textZh: 他带我进入酒室， 含情脉脉地望着我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他带我进入酒室， 含情脉脉地望着我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他带我入筵宴所， 以爱为旗在我以上。
verses.textEnNiv: Let him lead me to the banquet hall, and let his banner over me be love.
verses.textEnEsv: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.
verses.textEnNkjv: He brought me to the banqueting house, And his banner over me was love.
verses.textEnNlt: He escorts me to the banquet hall; it’s obvious how much he loves me.
verses.textEnNasb: "He has brought me to his banquet hall, And his banner over me is love.
verses.textEn: Let him lead me to the banquet hall, and let his banner over me be love.

verses.textZh: 求你们用葡萄饼增补我力， 用苹果恢复我的精神， 因为我因爱成病。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你们用葡萄饼增补我力， 用苹果恢复我的精神， 因为我因爱成病。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你们给我葡萄干增补我力， 给我苹果畅快我心， 因我思爱成病。
verses.textEnNiv: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples, for I am faint with love.
verses.textEnEsv: Sustain me with raisins; refresh me with apples, for I am sick with love.
verses.textEnNkjv: Sustain me with cakes of raisins, Refresh me with apples, For I am lovesick.
verses.textEnNlt: Strengthen me with raisin cakes, refresh me with apples, for I am weak with love.
verses.textEnNasb: "Refresh me with raisin cakes, Sustain me with apples, Because I am lovesick.
verses.textEn: Strengthen me with raisins, refresh me with apples, for I am faint with love.

verses.textZh: 他的左手托住我的头， 他的右手拥抱着我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的左手托住我的头， 他的右手拥抱着我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的左手在我头下； 他的右手将我抱住。
verses.textEnNiv: His left arm is under my head, and his right arm embraces me.
verses.textEnEsv: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand embraces me!
verses.textEnNkjv: His left hand is under my head, And his right hand embraces me.
verses.textEnNlt: His left arm is under my head, and his right arm embraces me.
verses.textEnNasb: "His left hand is under my head, And his right hand embraces me." The Groom
verses.textEn: His left arm is under my head, and his right arm embraces me.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！ 我指着田野的羚羊、母鹿恳求你们， 不要激动，不要挑动爱情， 等它自发吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！ 我指着田野的羚羊、母鹿恳求你们， 不要激动，不要挑动爱情， 等它自发吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊， 我指着羚羊或田野的母鹿嘱咐你们： 不要惊动、不要叫醒我所亲爱的， 等他自己情愿 。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you by the gazelles and by the does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires.
verses.textEnEsv: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles or the does of the field, that you not stir up or awaken love until it pleases.
verses.textEnNkjv: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, By the gazelles or by the does of the field, Do not stir up nor awaken love Until it pleases. The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: Promise me, O women of Jerusalem, by the gazelles and wild deer, not to awaken love until the time is right.
verses.textEnNasb: "Swear to me, you daughters of Jerusalem, By the gazelles or by the does of the field, That you will not disturb or awaken my love Until she pleases." The Bride
verses.textEn: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you by the gazelles and by the does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires.

verses.textZh: 听啊！这是我良人的声音， 他蹿山越岭而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 听啊！这是我良人的声音， 他蹿山越岭而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 听啊！是我良人的声音； 看哪！他蹿山越岭而来。
verses.textEnNiv: Listen! My beloved! Look! Here he comes, leaping across the mountains, bounding over the hills.
verses.textEnEsv: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes, leaping over the mountains, bounding over the hills.
verses.textEnNkjv: The voice of my beloved! Behold, he comes Leaping upon the mountains, Skipping upon the hills.
verses.textEnNlt: Ah, I hear my lover coming! He is leaping over the mountains, bounding over the hills.
verses.textEnNasb: "Listen! My beloved! Behold, he is coming, Leaping on the mountains, Jumping on the hills!
verses.textEn: Listen! My beloved! Look! Here he comes, leaping across the mountains, bounding over the hills.

verses.textZh: 我的良人像羚羊，像小鹿。 看哪！他站在我们的墙后； 从窗口观看， 从窗格往里面探视。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良人像羚羊，像小鹿。 看哪！他站在我们的墙后； 从窗口观看， 从窗格往里面探视。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的良人好像羚羊，或像小鹿。 他站在我们墙壁后， 从窗户往里观看， 从窗棂往里窥探。
verses.textEnNiv: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Look! There he stands behind our wall, gazing through the windows, peering through the lattice.
verses.textEnEsv: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Behold, there he stands behind our wall, gazing through the windows, looking through the lattice.
verses.textEnNkjv: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Behold, he stands behind our wall; He is looking through the windows, Gazing through the lattice.
verses.textEnNlt: My lover is like a swift gazelle or a young stag. Look, there he is behind the wall, looking through the window, peering into the room.
verses.textEnNasb: "My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Behold, he is standing behind our wall, He is looking through the windows, He is peering through the lattice.
verses.textEn: My beloved is like a gazelle or a young stag. Look! There he stands behind our wall, gazing through the windows, peering through the lattice.

verses.textZh: 我的良人对我说： "我的佳偶啊！你起来吧。 我的佳丽啊！你来吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良人对我说： "我的佳偶啊！你起来吧。 我的佳丽啊！你来吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 我良人对我说： 〔新郎〕 我的佳偶，我的美人， 起来，与我同去！
verses.textEnNiv: My beloved spoke and said to me, "Arise, my darling, my beautiful one, come with me.
verses.textEnEsv: My beloved speaks and says to me: "Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away,
verses.textEnNkjv: My beloved spoke, and said to me: "Rise up, my love, my fair one, And come away.
verses.textEnNlt: My lover said to me, "Rise up, my darling! Come away with me, my fair one!
verses.textEnNasb: "My beloved responded and said to me, ‘Arise, my darling, my beautiful one, And come along.
verses.textEn: My beloved spoke and said to me, "Arise, my darling, my beautiful one, come with me.

verses.textZh: 因为冬天已过， 雨水止息，已经过去了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为冬天已过， 雨水止息，已经过去了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为冬天已往， 雨水止住过去了。
verses.textEnNiv: See! The winter is past; the rains are over and gone.
verses.textEnEsv: for behold, the winter is past; the rain is over and gone.
verses.textEnNkjv: For lo, the winter is past, The rain is over and gone.
verses.textEnNlt: Look, the winter is past, and the rains are over and gone.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘For behold, the winter is past, The rain is over and gone.
verses.textEn: See! The winter is past; the rains are over and gone.

verses.textZh: 地上百花齐放， 百鸟齐鸣的时候已经来到； 斑鸠的声音在我们境内也听见了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 地上百花齐放， 百鸟齐鸣的时候已经来到； 斑鸠的声音在我们境内也听见了。
verses.textZhCuv: 地上百花开放， 百鸟鸣叫的时候 已经来到； 斑鸠的声音在我们境内也听见了。
verses.textEnNiv: Flowers appear on the earth; the season of singing has come, the cooing of doves is heard in our land.
verses.textEnEsv: The flowers appear on the earth, the time of singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land.
verses.textEnNkjv: The flowers appear on the earth; The time of singing has come, And the voice of the turtledove Is heard in our land.
verses.textEnNlt: The flowers are springing up, the season of singing birds has come, and the cooing of turtledoves fills the air.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The blossoms have already appeared in the land; The time has arrived for pruning the vines, And the voice of the turtledove has been heard in our land.
verses.textEn: Flowers appear on the earth; the season of singing has come, the cooing of doves is heard in our land.

verses.textZh: 无花果树的果子渐渐成熟， 葡萄树开花发香， 我的佳偶啊！你起来吧。 我的佳丽啊！你来吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 无花果树的果子渐渐成熟， 葡萄树开花发香， 我的佳偶啊！你起来吧。 我的佳丽啊！你来吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 无花果树的果子渐渐成熟； 葡萄树开花放香。 我的佳偶，我的美人， 起来，与我同去！
verses.textEnNiv: The fig tree forms its early fruit; the blossoming vines spread their fragrance. Arise, come, my darling; my beautiful one, come with me." He
verses.textEnEsv: The fig tree ripens its figs, and the vines are in blossom; they give forth fragrance. Arise, my love, my beautiful one, and come away.
verses.textEnNkjv: The fig tree puts forth her green figs, And the vines with the tender grapes Give a good smell. Rise up, my love, my fair one, And come away!
verses.textEnNlt: The fig trees are forming young fruit, and the fragrant grapevines are blossoming. Rise up, my darling! Come away with me, my fair one!" Young Man
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The fig tree has ripened its fruit, And the vines in blossom have given forth their fragrance. Arise, my darling, my beautiful one, And come along!’ " The Groom
verses.textEn: The fig tree forms its early fruit; the blossoming vines spread their fragrance. Arise, come, my darling; my beautiful one, come with me." He

verses.textZh: 我的鸽子啊！在岩石的穴中， 在悬崖石的隐密处， 让我看看你的容貌； 让我听听你的声音； 因为你的声音甜美， 你的容貌秀丽。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的鸽子啊！在岩石的穴中， 在悬崖石的隐密处， 让我看看你的容貌； 让我听听你的声音； 因为你的声音甜美， 你的容貌秀丽。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的鸽子啊，你在磐石穴中， 在陡岩的隐密处。 求你容我得见你的面貌， 得听你的声音； 因为你的声音柔和， 你的面貌秀美。
verses.textEnNiv: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places on the mountainside, show me your face, let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet, and your face is lovely.
verses.textEnEsv: O my dove, in the clefts of the rock, in the crannies of the cliff, let me see your face, let me hear your voice, for your voice is sweet, and your face is lovely.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O my dove, in the clefts of the rock, In the secret places of the cliff, Let me see your face, Let me hear your voice; For your voice is sweet, And your face is lovely." Her Brothers
verses.textEnNlt: My dove is hiding behind the rocks, behind an outcrop on the cliff. Let me see your face; let me hear your voice. For your voice is pleasant, and your face is lovely. Young Women of Jerusalem
verses.textEnNasb: "My dove, in the clefts of the rock, In the hiding place of the mountain pathway, Let me see how you look, Let me hear your voice; For your voice is pleasant, And you look delightful." The Chorus
verses.textEn: My dove in the clefts of the rock, in the hiding places on the mountainside, show me your face, let me hear your voice; for your voice is sweet, and your face is lovely.

verses.textZh: 要为我们捉拿狐狸， 就是毁坏葡萄园的小狐狸， 因为我们的葡萄园正在开花。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 要为我们捉拿狐狸， 就是毁坏葡萄园的小狐狸， 因为我们的葡萄园正在开花。"
verses.textZhCuv: 要给我们擒拿狐狸， 就是毁坏葡萄园的小狐狸， 因为我们的葡萄正在开花。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that ruin the vineyards, our vineyards that are in bloom. She
verses.textEnEsv: Catch the foxes for us, the little foxes that spoil the vineyards, for our vineyards are in blossom."
verses.textEnNkjv: Catch us the foxes, The little foxes that spoil the vines, For our vines have tender grapes. The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: Catch all the foxes, those little foxes, before they ruin the vineyard of love, for the grapevines are blossoming! Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: "Catch the foxes for us, The little foxes that are ruining the vineyards, While our vineyards are in blossom." The Bride
verses.textEn: Catch for us the foxes, the little foxes that ruin the vineyards, our vineyards that are in bloom. She

verses.textZh: 我的良人属我，我也属他， 他在百合花中细赏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良人属我，我也属他， 他在百合花中细赏。
verses.textZhCuv: 良人属我，我也属他； 他在百合花中牧放群羊。
verses.textEnNiv: My beloved is mine and I am his; he browses among the lilies.
verses.textEnEsv: My beloved is mine, and I am his; he grazes among the lilies.
verses.textEnNkjv: My beloved is mine, and I am his. He feeds hisflock among the lilies. (To Her Beloved)
verses.textEnNlt: My lover is mine, and I am his. He browses among the lilies.
verses.textEnNasb: "My beloved is mine, and I am his; He pastures his flock among the lilies.
verses.textEn: My beloved is mine and I am his; he browses among the lilies.

verses.textZh: 我的良人啊！ 等到天起凉风，日影消逝的时候， 愿你归来， 好象崎岖山上的羚羊或是小鹿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良人啊！ 等到天起凉风，日影消逝的时候， 愿你归来， 好象崎岖山上的羚羊或是小鹿。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的良人哪， 求你等到天起凉风、 日影飞去的时候， 你要转回，好像羚羊， 或像小鹿在比特山上。
verses.textEnNiv: Until the day breaks and the shadows flee, turn, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or like a young stag on the rugged hills.
verses.textEnEsv: Until the day breathes and the shadows flee, turn, my beloved, be like a gazelle or a young stag on cleft mountains.
verses.textEnNkjv: Until the day breaks And the shadows flee away, Turn, my beloved, And be like a gazelle Or a young stag Upon the mountains of Bether.
verses.textEnNlt: Before the dawn breezes blow and the night shadows flee, return to me, my love, like a gazelle or a young stag on the rugged mountains.
verses.textEnNasb: "Until the cool of the day, when the shadows flee, Turn, my beloved, and be like a gazelle Or a young stag on the mountains of Bether."
verses.textEn: Until the day breaks and the shadows flee, turn, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or like a young stag on the rugged hills.

verses.textZh: 我夜间躺在床上， 寻找我心所爱的， 我寻找他，却找不到他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我夜间躺在床上， 寻找我心所爱的， 我寻找他，却找不到他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我夜间躺卧在床上， 寻找我心所爱的； 我寻找他，却寻不见。
verses.textEnNiv: All night long on my bed I looked for the one my heart loves; I looked for him but did not find him.
verses.textEnEsv: On my bed by night I sought him whom my soul loves; I sought him, but found him not.
verses.textEnNkjv: By night on my bed I sought the one I love; I sought him, but I did not find him.
verses.textEnNlt: One night as I lay in bed, I yearned for my lover. I yearned for him, but he did not come.
verses.textEnNasb: "On my bed night after night I sought him Whom my soul loves; I sought him but did not find him.
verses.textEn: All night long on my bed I looked for the one my heart loves; I looked for him but did not find him.

verses.textZh: 我说："我要起来，走遍全城， 在街上，在广场上， 寻找我心所爱的。" 我寻找他，却找不到他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说："我要起来，走遍全城， 在街上，在广场上， 寻找我心所爱的。" 我寻找他，却找不到他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：我要起来，游行城中， 在街市上，在宽阔处， 寻找我心所爱的。 我寻找他，却寻不见。
verses.textEnNiv: I will get up now and go about the city, through its streets and squares; I will search for the one my heart loves. So I looked for him but did not find him.
verses.textEnEsv: I will rise now and go about the city, in the streets and in the squares; I will seek him whom my soul loves. I sought him, but found him not.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I will rise now," Isaid, "And go about the city; In the streets and in the squares I will seek the one I love." I sought him, but I did not find him.
verses.textEnNlt: So I said to myself, "I will get up and roam the city, searching in all its streets and squares. I will search for the one I love." So I searched everywhere but did not find him.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘ I must arise now and go around in the city; In the streets and in the public squares I must seek him whom my soul loves.’ I sought him but did not find him.
verses.textEn: I will get up now and go about the city, through its streets and squares; I will search for the one my heart loves. So I looked for him but did not find him.

verses.textZh: 城中的守卫巡逻的时候，找着我； 我就问他们："你们有没有看见我心所爱的？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 城中的守卫巡逻的时候，找着我； 我就问他们："你们有没有看见我心所爱的？"
verses.textZhCuv: 城中巡逻看守的人遇见我； 我问他们：你们看见我心所爱的没有？
verses.textEnNiv: The watchmen found me as they made their rounds in the city. "Have you seen the one my heart loves?"
verses.textEnEsv: The watchmen found me as they went about in the city. "Have you seen him whom my soul loves?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The watchmen who go about the city found me; Isaid, "Have you seen the one I love?"
verses.textEnNlt: The watchmen stopped me as they made their rounds, and I asked, "Have you seen the one I love?"
verses.textEnNasb: "The watchmen who make the rounds in the city found me, And I said, ‘Have you seen him whom my soul loves?’
verses.textEn: The watchmen found me as they made their rounds in the city. "Have you seen the one my heart loves?"

verses.textZh: 我刚刚离开他们， 就遇见我心所爱的； 我把他拉住，不让他走， 等到我带他到我母亲的家， 进到怀我者的内室。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我刚刚离开他们， 就遇见我心所爱的； 我把他拉住，不让他走， 等到我带他到我母亲的家， 进到怀我者的内室。
verses.textZhCuv: 我刚离开他们就遇见我心所爱的。 我拉住他，不容他走， 领他入我母家， 到怀我者的内室。
verses.textEnNiv: Scarcely had I passed them when I found the one my heart loves. I held him and would not let him go till I had brought him to my mother’s house, to the room of the one who conceived me.
verses.textEnEsv: Scarcely had I passed them when I found him whom my soul loves. I held him, and would not let him go until I had brought him into my mother’s house, and into the chamber of her who conceived me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Scarcely had I passed by them, When I found the one I love. I held him and would not let him go, Until I had brought him to the house of my mother, And into the chamber of her who conceived me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then scarcely had I left them when I found my love! I caught and held him tightly, then I brought him to my mother’s house, into my mother’s bed, where I had been conceived.
verses.textEnNasb: "Hardly had I left them When I found him whom my soul loves; I held on to him and would not let him go Until I had brought him to my mother’s house, And into the room of her who conceived me." The Groom
verses.textEn: Scarcely had I passed them when I found the one my heart loves. I held him and would not let him go till I had brought him to my mother’s house, to the room of the one who conceived me.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！ 我指着羚羊、田间的母鹿恳求你们， 不要激动，不要挑动爱情， 等它自发吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！ 我指着羚羊、田间的母鹿恳求你们， 不要激动，不要挑动爱情， 等它自发吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊， 我指着羚羊或田野的母鹿嘱咐你们： 不要惊动、不要叫醒我所亲爱的， 等他自己情愿 。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you by the gazelles and by the does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires.
verses.textEnEsv: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, by the gazelles or the does of the field, that you not stir up or awaken love until it pleases.
verses.textEnNkjv: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, By the gazelles or by the does of the field, Do not stir up nor awaken love Until it pleases. The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: Promise me, O women of Jerusalem, by the gazelles and wild deer, not to awaken love until the time is right. Young Women of Jerusalem
verses.textEnNasb: "Swear to me, you daughters of Jerusalem, By the gazelles or by the does of the field, That you will not disturb or awaken my love Until she pleases." The Bride
verses.textEn: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you by the gazelles and by the does of the field: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires.

verses.textZh: 那从旷野上来， 好象烟柱； 用商人贩卖的各种香粉、 没药和乳香熏过的，是谁呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 那从旷野上来， 好象烟柱； 用商人贩卖的各种香粉、 没药和乳香熏过的，是谁呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 那从旷野上来、形状如烟柱、 以没药和乳香并商人各样香粉薰的是谁呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who is this coming up from the wilderness like a column of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and incense made from all the spices of the merchant?
verses.textEnEsv: What is that coming up from the wilderness like columns of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all the fragrant powders of a merchant?
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is this coming out of the wilderness Like pillars of smoke, Perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, With all the merchant’s fragrant powders?
verses.textEnNlt: Who is this sweeping in from the wilderness like a cloud of smoke? Who is it, fragrant with myrrh and frankincense and every kind of spice?
verses.textEnNasb: " What is this coming up from the wilderness Like columns of smoke, Perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, With all the scented powders of the merchant? The Chorus
verses.textEn: Who is this coming up from the wilderness like a column of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and incense made from all the spices of the merchant?

verses.textZh: 看哪！是所罗门的御轿， 四周有六十个勇士， 都是以色列中的勇士。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看哪！是所罗门的御轿， 四周有六十个勇士， 都是以色列中的勇士。
verses.textZhCuv: 看哪，是所罗门的轿； 四围有六十个勇士， 都是以色列中的勇士；
verses.textEnNiv: Look! It is Solomon’s carriage, escorted by sixty warriors, the noblest of Israel,
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, it is the litter of Solomon! Around it are sixty mighty men, some of the mighty men of Israel,
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, it is Solomon’s couch, With sixty valiant men around it, Of the valiant of Israel.
verses.textEnNlt: Look, it is Solomon’s carriage, surrounded by sixty heroic men, the best of Israel’s soldiers.
verses.textEnNasb: "Behold, it is the traveling couch of Solomon; Sixty warriors around it, Of the warriors of Israel.
verses.textEn: Look! It is Solomon’s carriage, escorted by sixty warriors, the noblest of Israel,

verses.textZh: 个个手拿武器，能征惯战； 各人腿上配有利剑，以防夜间的袭击。
verses.textZhCnvs: 个个手拿武器，能征惯战； 各人腿上配有利剑，以防夜间的袭击。
verses.textZhCuv: 手都持刀，善于争战， 腰间佩刀，防备夜间有惊慌。
verses.textEnNiv: all of them wearing the sword, all experienced in battle, each with his sword at his side, prepared for the terrors of the night.
verses.textEnEsv: all of them wearing swords and expert in war, each with his sword at his thigh, against terror by night.
verses.textEnNkjv: They all hold swords, Being expert in war. Every man has his sword on his thigh Because of fear in the night.
verses.textEnNlt: They are all skilled swordsmen, experienced warriors. Each wears a sword on his thigh, ready to defend the king against an attack in the night.
verses.textEnNasb: "All of them are wielders of the sword, Expert in war; Each man has his sword at his side, Guarding against the terrors of the night.
verses.textEn: all of them wearing the sword, all experienced in battle, each with his sword at his side, prepared for the terrors of the night.

verses.textZh: 所罗门王用黎巴嫩木， 为自己做了一乘华轿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门王用黎巴嫩木， 为自己做了一乘华轿。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门王用黎巴嫩木 为自己制造一乘华轿。
verses.textEnNiv: King Solomon made for himself the carriage; he made it of wood from Lebanon.
verses.textEnEsv: King Solomon made himself a carriage from the wood of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Of the wood of Lebanon Solomon the King Made himself a palanquin:
verses.textEnNlt: King Solomon’s carriage is built of wood imported from Lebanon.
verses.textEnNasb: "King Solomon has made for himself a sedan chair From the timber of Lebanon.
verses.textEn: King Solomon made for himself the carriage; he made it of wood from Lebanon.

verses.textZh: 他用银子做轿柱， 用金子做轿底， 用紫色料子做轿的座垫； 内部所铺设的， 是耶路撒冷众女子的爱情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他用银子做轿柱， 用金子做轿底， 用紫色料子做轿的座垫； 内部所铺设的， 是耶路撒冷众女子的爱情。
verses.textZhCuv: 轿柱是用银做的， 轿底是用金做的； 坐垫是紫色的， 其中所铺的乃耶路撒冷众女子的爱情。
verses.textEnNiv: Its posts he made of silver, its base of gold. Its seat was upholstered with purple, its interior inlaid with love. Daughters of Jerusalem,
verses.textEnEsv: He made its posts of silver, its back of gold, its seat of purple; its interior was inlaid with love by the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: He made its pillars of silver, Its support of gold, Its seat of purple, Its interior paved with love By the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: Its posts are silver, its canopy gold; its cushions are purple. It was decorated with love by the young women of Jerusalem. Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: "He made its posts of silver, Its back of gold And its seat of purple fabric, With its interior lovingly inlaid By the daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: Its posts he made of silver, its base of gold. Its seat was upholstered with purple, its interior inlaid with love. Daughters of Jerusalem,

verses.textZh: 锡安的众女子啊！ 你们出来看看所罗门戴着的冠冕， 就是在他结婚的日子， 在他心里喜乐的时候， 他母亲给他戴上的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 锡安的众女子啊！ 你们出来看看所罗门戴着的冠冕， 就是在他结婚的日子， 在他心里喜乐的时候， 他母亲给他戴上的。
verses.textZhCuv: 锡安的众女子啊， 你们出去观看所罗门王！ 头戴冠冕，就是在他婚筵的日子、 心中喜乐的时候，他母亲给他戴上的。
verses.textEnNiv: come out, and look, you daughters of Zion. Look on King Solomon wearing a crown, the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding, the day his heart rejoiced.
verses.textEnEsv: Go out, O daughters of Zion, and look upon King Solomon, with the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding, on the day of the gladness of his heart.
verses.textEnNkjv: Go forth, O daughters of Zion, And see King Solomon with the crown With which his mother crowned him On the day of his wedding, The day of the gladness of his heart.
verses.textEnNlt: Come out to see King Solomon, young women of Jerusalem. He wears the crown his mother gave him on his wedding day, his most joyous day.
verses.textEnNasb: "Go out, you daughters of Zion, And look at King Solomon with the crown With which his mother has crowned him On the day of his wedding, And on the day of the joy of his heart."
verses.textEn: come out, and look, you daughters of Zion. Look on King Solomon wearing a crown, the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding, the day his heart rejoiced.

verses.textZh: 我的佳偶啊！你很美丽； 你很美丽。 你的眼在面纱后面好象鸽子的眼睛； 头发如同从基列山下来的山羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的佳偶啊！你很美丽； 你很美丽。 你的眼在面纱后面好象鸽子的眼睛； 头发如同从基列山下来的山羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的佳偶，你甚美丽！你甚美丽！ 你的眼在帕子内好像鸽子眼。 你的头发如同山羊群卧在基列山旁。
verses.textEnNiv: How beautiful you are, my darling! Oh, how beautiful! Your eyes behind your veil are doves. Your hair is like a flock of goats descending from the hills of Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: Behold, you are beautiful, my love, behold, you are beautiful! Your eyes are doves behind your veil. Your hair is like a flock of goats leaping down the slopes of Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Behold, you are fair, my love! Behold, you are fair! You have dove’s eyes behind your veil. Your hair is like a flock of goats, Going down from Mount Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: You are beautiful, my darling, beautiful beyond words. Your eyes are like doves behind your veil. Your hair falls in waves, like a flock of goats winding down the slopes of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: " How beautiful you are, my darling, How beautiful you are! Your eyes are like doves behind your veil; Your hair is like a flock of goats That have descended from Mount Gilead.
verses.textEn: How beautiful you are, my darling! Oh, how beautiful! Your eyes behind your veil are doves. Your hair is like a flock of goats descending from the hills of Gilead.

verses.textZh: 你的牙齿像新剪毛的一群母羊， 刚刚洗净那样洁白整齐； 牠们成双成对， 没有单独一只的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的牙齿像新剪毛的一群母羊， 刚刚洗净那样洁白整齐； 牠们成双成对， 没有单独一只的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的牙齿如新剪毛的一群母羊， 洗净上来，个个都有双生， 没有一只丧掉子的。
verses.textEnNiv: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep just shorn, coming up from the washing. Each has its twin; not one of them is alone.
verses.textEnEsv: Your teeth are like a flock of shorn ewes that have come up from the washing, all of which bear twins, and not one among them has lost its young.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your teeth are like a flock of shorn sheep Which have come up from the washing, Every one of which bears twins, And none is barren among them.
verses.textEnNlt: Your teeth are as white as sheep, recently shorn and freshly washed. Your smile is flawless, each tooth matched with its twin.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your teeth are like a flock of newly shorn sheep Which have come up from their watering place, All of which bear twins, And not one among them has lost her young.
verses.textEn: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep just shorn, coming up from the washing. Each has its twin; not one of them is alone.

verses.textZh: 你的嘴唇像一条朱红线， 你的小嘴美丽； 你的两颊在面纱后面， 如同切开的石榴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的嘴唇像一条朱红线， 你的小嘴美丽； 你的两颊在面纱后面， 如同切开的石榴。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的唇好像一条朱红线； 你的嘴也秀美。 你的两太阳在帕子内， 如同一块石榴。
verses.textEnNiv: Your lips are like a scarlet ribbon; your mouth is lovely. Your temples behind your veil are like the halves of a pomegranate.
verses.textEnEsv: Your lips are like a scarlet thread, and your mouth is lovely. Your cheeks are like halves of a pomegranate behind your veil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your lips are like a strand of scarlet, And your mouth is lovely. Your temples behind your veil Are like a piece of pomegranate.
verses.textEnNlt: Your lips are like scarlet ribbon; your mouth is inviting. Your cheeks are like rosy pomegranates behind your veil.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your lips are like a scarlet thread, And your mouth is beautiful. Your temples are like a slice of a pomegranate Behind your veil.
verses.textEn: Your lips are like a scarlet ribbon; your mouth is lovely. Your temples behind your veil are like the halves of a pomegranate.

verses.textZh: 你的颈项像大卫的城楼， 建造得十分整齐、雅观； 其上悬挂着一千个盾牌， 都是勇士的武器。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的颈项像大卫的城楼， 建造得十分整齐、雅观； 其上悬挂着一千个盾牌， 都是勇士的武器。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的颈项好像大卫建造收藏军器的高台， 其上悬挂一千盾牌， 都是勇士的藤牌。
verses.textEnNiv: Your neck is like the tower of David, built with courses of stone ; on it hang a thousand shields, all of them shields of warriors.
verses.textEnEsv: Your neck is like the tower of David, built in rows of stone; on it hang a thousand shields, all of them shields of warriors.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your neck is like the tower of David, Built for an armory, On which hang a thousand bucklers, All shields of mighty men.
verses.textEnNlt: Your neck is as beautiful as the tower of David, jeweled with the shields of a thousand heroes.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your neck is like the tower of David, Built with layers of stones On which are hung a thousand shields, All the round shields of the warriors.
verses.textEn: Your neck is like the tower of David, built with courses of stone ; on it hang a thousand shields, all of them shields of warriors.

verses.textZh: 你的两乳像双生的母羚羊， 是在百合花中吃草的一对小鹿。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的两乳像双生的母羚羊， 是在百合花中吃草的一对小鹿。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的两乳好像百合花中吃草的一对小鹿， 就是母鹿双生的。
verses.textEnNiv: Your breasts are like two fawns, like twin fawns of a gazelle that browse among the lilies.
verses.textEnEsv: Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle, that graze among the lilies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your two breasts are like two fawns, Twins of a gazelle, Which feed among the lilies.
verses.textEnNlt: Your breasts are like two fawns, twin fawns of a gazelle grazing among the lilies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your two breasts are like two fawns, Twins of a gazelle That graze among the lilies.
verses.textEn: Your breasts are like two fawns, like twin fawns of a gazelle that browse among the lilies.

verses.textZh: 等到晚风徐来， 日影消逝的时候， 我要亲自到没药山， 要往乳香冈去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 等到晚风徐来， 日影消逝的时候， 我要亲自到没药山， 要往乳香冈去。
verses.textZhCuv: 我要往没药山和乳香冈去， 直等到天起凉风、 日影飞去的时候回来。
verses.textEnNiv: Until the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will go to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of incense.
verses.textEnEsv: Until the day breathes and the shadows flee, I will go away to the mountain of myrrh and the hill of frankincense.
verses.textEnNkjv: Until the day breaks And the shadows flee away, I will go my way to the mountain of myrrh And to the hill of frankincense.
verses.textEnNlt: Before the dawn breezes blow and the night shadows flee, I will hurry to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of frankincense.
verses.textEnNasb: "Until the cool of the day When the shadows flee, I will go my way to the mountain of myrrh And to the hill of frankincense.
verses.textEn: Until the day breaks and the shadows flee, I will go to the mountain of myrrh and to the hill of incense.

verses.textZh: 我的佳偶啊！你全然美丽， 毫无瑕疵。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的佳偶啊！你全然美丽， 毫无瑕疵。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的佳偶，你全然美丽， 毫无瑕疵！
verses.textEnNiv: You are altogether beautiful, my darling; there is no flaw in you.
verses.textEnEsv: You are altogether beautiful, my love; there is no flaw in you.
verses.textEnNkjv: You are all fair, my love, And thereis no spot in you.
verses.textEnNlt: You are altogether beautiful, my darling, beautiful in every way.
verses.textEnNasb: "You are altogether beautiful, my darling, And there is no blemish on you.
verses.textEn: You are altogether beautiful, my darling; there is no flaw in you.

verses.textZh: 我的新妇啊！与我同去黎巴嫩山。 与我前往黎巴嫩山。 从亚玛拿山顶， 从示尼珥和黑门山顶， 从狮子洞，从豹子山俯望。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的新妇啊！与我同去黎巴嫩山。 与我前往黎巴嫩山。 从亚玛拿山顶， 从示尼珥和黑门山顶， 从狮子洞，从豹子山俯望。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的新妇，求你与我一同离开黎巴嫩， 与我一同离开黎巴嫩。 从亚玛拿顶， 从示尼珥与黑门顶， 从有狮子的洞， 从有豹子的山往下观看。
verses.textEnNiv: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, come with me from Lebanon. Descend from the crest of Amana, from the top of Senir, the summit of Hermon, from the lions’ dens and the mountain haunts of leopards.
verses.textEnEsv: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride; come with me from Lebanon. Depart from the peak of Amana, from the peak of Senir and Hermon, from the dens of lions, from the mountains of leopards.
verses.textEnNkjv: Come with me from Lebanon, my spouse, With me from Lebanon. Look from the top of Amana, From the top of Senir and Hermon, From the lions’ dens, From the mountains of the leopards.
verses.textEnNlt: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, come with me from Lebanon. Come down from Mount Amana, from the peaks of Senir and Hermon, where the lions have their dens and leopards live among the hills.
verses.textEnNasb: "Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, You shall come with me from Lebanon. You shall come down from the summit of Amana, From the summit of Senir and Hermon, From the dens of lions, From the mountains of leopards.
verses.textEn: Come with me from Lebanon, my bride, come with me from Lebanon. Descend from the crest of Amana, from the top of Senir, the summit of Hermon, from the lions’ dens and the mountain haunts of leopards.

verses.textZh: 我的妹妹，我的新妇啊！你夺去了我的心。 你用你的眼神、 用你项链上的一颗珍珠夺去了我的心。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的妹妹，我的新妇啊！你夺去了我的心。 你用你的眼神、 用你项链上的一颗珍珠夺去了我的心。
verses.textZhCuv: 我妹子，我新妇， 你夺了我的心。 你用眼一看， 用你项上的一条金链， 夺了我的心！
verses.textEnNiv: You have stolen my heart, my sister, my bride; you have stolen my heart with one glance of your eyes, with one jewel of your necklace.
verses.textEnEsv: You have captivated my heart, my sister, my bride; you have captivated my heart with one glance of your eyes, with one jewel of your necklace.
verses.textEnNkjv: You have ravished my heart, My sister, my spouse; You have ravished my heart With one look of your eyes, With one link of your necklace.
verses.textEnNlt: You have captured my heart, my treasure, my bride. You hold it hostage with one glance of your eyes, with a single jewel of your necklace.
verses.textEnNasb: "You have enchanted my heart, my sister, my bride; You have enchanted my heart with a single glance of your eyes, With a single strand of your necklace.
verses.textEn: You have stolen my heart, my sister, my bride; you have stolen my heart with one glance of your eyes, with one jewel of your necklace.

verses.textZh: 我的妹妹，我的新妇啊！ 你的爱情多么美丽。 你的爱情比酒更好。 你膏油的香气胜过一切香料。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的妹妹，我的新妇啊！ 你的爱情多么美丽。 你的爱情比酒更好。 你膏油的香气胜过一切香料。
verses.textZhCuv: 我妹子，我新妇， 你的爱情何其美！ 你的爱情比酒更美！ 你膏油的香气胜过一切香品！
verses.textEnNiv: How delightful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much more pleasing is your love than wine, and the fragrance of your perfume more than any spice!
verses.textEnEsv: How beautiful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much better is your love than wine, and the fragrance of your oils than any spice!
verses.textEnNkjv: How fair is your love, My sister, my spouse! How much better than wine is your love, And the scent of your perfumes Than all spices!
verses.textEnNlt: Your love delights me, my treasure, my bride. Your love is better than wine, your perfume more fragrant than spices.
verses.textEnNasb: "How beautiful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much sweeter is your love than wine, And the fragrance of your oils Than that of all kinds of balsam oils!
verses.textEn: How delightful is your love, my sister, my bride! How much more pleasing is your love than wine, and the fragrance of your perfume more than any spice!

verses.textZh: 我的新妇啊！你的嘴唇滴蜜，好象蜂房滴蜜； 你的舌下有蜜有奶； 你衣服的香气好象黎巴嫩山的香气。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的新妇啊！你的嘴唇滴蜜，好象蜂房滴蜜； 你的舌下有蜜有奶； 你衣服的香气好象黎巴嫩山的香气。
verses.textZhCuv: 我新妇，你的嘴唇滴蜜， 好像蜂房滴蜜； 你的舌下有蜜，有奶。 你衣服的香气如黎巴嫩的香气。
verses.textEnNiv: Your lips drop sweetness as the honeycomb, my bride; milk and honey are under your tongue. The fragrance of your garments is like the fragrance of Lebanon.
verses.textEnEsv: Your lips drip nectar, my bride; honey and milk are under your tongue; the fragrance of your garments is like the fragrance of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your lips, O my spouse, Drip as the honeycomb; Honey and milk are under your tongue; And the fragrance of your garments Is like the fragrance of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNlt: Your lips are as sweet as nectar, my bride. Honey and milk are under your tongue. Your clothes are scented like the cedars of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your lips drip honey, my bride; Honey and milk are under your tongue, And the fragrance of your garments is like the fragrance of Lebanon.
verses.textEn: Your lips drop sweetness as the honeycomb, my bride; milk and honey are under your tongue. The fragrance of your garments is like the fragrance of Lebanon.

verses.textZh: 我的妹妹，我的新妇，是上了闩的园子， 是上了锁的水井，是封闭了的泉源。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的妹妹，我的新妇，是上了闩的园子， 是上了锁的水井，是封闭了的泉源。
verses.textZhCuv: 我妹子，我新妇， 乃是关锁的园， 禁闭的井，封闭的泉源。
verses.textEnNiv: You are a garden locked up, my sister, my bride; you are a spring enclosed, a sealed fountain.
verses.textEnEsv: A garden locked is my sister, my bride, a spring locked, a fountain sealed.
verses.textEnNkjv: A garden enclosed Is my sister, my spouse, A spring shut up, A fountain sealed.
verses.textEnNlt: You are my private garden, my treasure, my bride, a secluded spring, a hidden fountain.
verses.textEnNasb: "A locked garden is my sister, my bride, A locked spring, a sealed fountain.
verses.textEn: You are a garden locked up, my sister, my bride; you are a spring enclosed, a sealed fountain.

verses.textZh: 你所栽种的是一所石榴园， 有极美的果子，有凤仙花和哪哒树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所栽种的是一所石榴园， 有极美的果子，有凤仙花和哪哒树。
verses.textZhCuv: 你园内所种的结了石榴， 有佳美的果子， 并凤仙花与哪哒树。
verses.textEnNiv: Your plants are an orchard of pomegranates with choice fruits, with henna and nard,
verses.textEnEsv: Your shoots are an orchard of pomegranates with all choicest fruits, henna with nard,
verses.textEnNkjv: Your plants are an orchard of pomegranates With pleasant fruits, Fragrant henna with spikenard,
verses.textEnNlt: Your thighs shelter a paradise of pomegranates with rare spices— henna with nard,
verses.textEnNasb: "Your branches are an orchard of pomegranates With delicious fruits, henna with nard plants,
verses.textEn: Your plants are an orchard of pomegranates with choice fruits, with henna and nard,

verses.textZh: 有哪哒和番红花，菖蒲和肉桂， 以及各种乳香树、 没药和沉香，与各样精选的香料。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有哪哒和番红花，菖蒲和肉桂， 以及各种乳香树、 没药和沉香，与各样精选的香料。
verses.textZhCuv: 有哪哒和番红花， 菖蒲和桂树， 并各样乳香木、没药、沉香， 与一切上等的果品。
verses.textEnNiv: nard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of incense tree, with myrrh and aloes and all the finest spices.
verses.textEnEsv: nard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense, myrrh and aloes, with all choice spices—
verses.textEnNkjv: Spikenard and saffron, Calamus and cinnamon, With all trees of frankincense, Myrrh and aloes, With all the chief spices—
verses.textEnNlt: nard and saffron, fragrant calamus and cinnamon, with all the trees of frankincense, myrrh, and aloes, and every other lovely spice.
verses.textEnNasb: Nard and saffron, spice reed and cinnamon, With all the trees of frankincense, Myrrh, and aloes, along with all the finest balsam oils.
verses.textEn: nard and saffron, calamus and cinnamon, with every kind of incense tree, with myrrh and aloes and all the finest spices.

verses.textZh: 你是园中的泉源， 是活水的井， 是从黎巴嫩山流下来的溪水。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你是园中的泉源， 是活水的井， 是从黎巴嫩山流下来的溪水。
verses.textZhCuv: 你是园中的泉，活水的井， 从黎巴嫩流下来的溪水。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: You are a garden fountain, a well of flowing water streaming down from Lebanon. She
verses.textEnEsv: a garden fountain, a well of living water, and flowing streams from Lebanon.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fountain of gardens, A well of living waters, And streams from Lebanon. The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: You are a garden fountain, a well of fresh water streaming down from Lebanon’s mountains. Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: "You are a garden spring, A well of fresh water, And flowing streams from Lebanon." The Bride
verses.textEn: You are a garden fountain, a well of flowing water streaming down from Lebanon. She

verses.textZh: 北风啊！兴起。 南风啊！吹来。 吹进我的园里， 让其中的香气散播出来。 愿我的良人进入他自己的园中， 享用他佳美的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 北风啊！兴起。 南风啊！吹来。 吹进我的园里， 让其中的香气散播出来。 愿我的良人进入他自己的园中， 享用他佳美的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 北风啊，兴起！ 南风啊，吹来！ 吹在我的园内， 使其中的香气发出来。 愿我的良人进入自己园里， 吃他佳美的果子。
verses.textEnNiv: Awake, north wind, and come, south wind! Blow on my garden, that its fragrance may spread everywhere. Let my beloved come into his garden and taste its choice fruits.
verses.textEnEsv: Awake, O north wind, and come, O south wind! Blow upon my garden, let its spices flow. She Let my beloved come to his garden, and eat its choicest fruits.
verses.textEnNkjv: Awake, O north wind, And come, O south! Blow upon my garden, That its spices may flow out. Let my beloved come to his garden And eat its pleasant fruits.
verses.textEnNlt: Awake, north wind! Rise up, south wind! Blow on my garden and spread its fragrance all around. Come into your garden, my love; taste its finest fruits.
verses.textEnNasb: "Awake, north wind, And come, wind of the south; Make my garden breathe out fragrance, May its balsam oils flow. May my beloved come into his garden And eat its delicious fruits!"
verses.textEn: Awake, north wind, and come, south wind! Blow on my garden, that its fragrance may spread everywhere. Let my beloved come into his garden and taste its choice fruits.

verses.textZh: 我的妹妹，我的新妇啊！我进了我的园中； 我采了我的没药与香料； 我吃了我的蜂房与蜂蜜； 我喝了我的酒和奶。 朋友们！你们要开怀吃喝； 亲爱的啊！你们要不醉无归。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的妹妹，我的新妇啊！我进了我的园中； 我采了我的没药与香料； 我吃了我的蜂房与蜂蜜； 我喝了我的酒和奶。 朋友们！你们要开怀吃喝； 亲爱的啊！你们要不醉无归。
verses.textZhCuv: 我妹子，我新妇， 我进了我的园中， 采了我的没药和香料， 吃了我的蜜房和蜂蜜， 喝了我的酒和奶。 〔耶路撒冷的众女子〕 我的朋友们，请吃！ 我所亲爱的，请喝，且多多地喝！ 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice. I have eaten my honeycomb and my honey; I have drunk my wine and my milk. Friends Eat, friends, and drink; drink your fill of love. She
verses.textEnEsv: I came to my garden, my sister, my bride, I gathered my myrrh with my spice, I ate my honeycomb with my honey, I drank my wine with my milk. Others Eat, friends, drink, and be drunk with love! She
verses.textEnNkjv: I have come to my garden, my sister, my spouse; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. (To His Friends) Eat, O friends! Drink, yes, drink deeply, O beloved ones! The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: I have entered my garden, my treasure, my bride! I gather myrrh with my spices and eat honeycomb with my honey. I drink wine with my milk. Young Women of Jerusalem Oh, lover and beloved, eat and drink! Yes, drink deeply of your love! Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: "I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh along with my balsam. I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Eat, friends; Drink and drink deeply, lovers." The Bride
verses.textEn: I have come into my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice. I have eaten my honeycomb and my honey; I have drunk my wine and my milk. Friends Eat, friends, and drink; drink your fill of love. She

verses.textZh: 我身虽然睡卧，我心却醒。 这是我的良人的声音，他敲着门说： "我的妹妹，我的佳偶， 我的鸽子，我的完全人哪！求你给我开门； 因为我的头满了露水， 头发给夜露滴湿。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我身虽然睡卧，我心却醒。 这是我的良人的声音，他敲着门说： "我的妹妹，我的佳偶， 我的鸽子，我的完全人哪！求你给我开门； 因为我的头满了露水， 头发给夜露滴湿。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我身睡卧，我心却醒。 这是我良人的声音； 他敲门说： 〔新郎〕 我的妹子，我的佳偶， 我的鸽子，我的完全人， 求你给我开门； 因我的头满了露水， 我的头发被夜露滴湿。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: I slept but my heart was awake. Listen! My beloved is knocking: "Open to me, my sister, my darling, my dove, my flawless one. My head is drenched with dew, my hair with the dampness of the night."
verses.textEnEsv: I slept, but my heart was awake. A sound! My beloved is knocking. "Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my perfect one, for my head is wet with dew, my locks with the drops of the night."
verses.textEnNkjv: I sleep, but my heart is awake; Itis the voice of my beloved! He knocks, saying, "Open for me, my sister, my love, My dove, my perfect one; For my head is covered with dew, My locks with the drops of the night."
verses.textEnNlt: I slept, but my heart was awake, when I heard my lover knocking and calling: "Open to me, my treasure, my darling, my dove, my perfect one. My head is drenched with dew, my hair with the dampness of the night."
verses.textEnNasb: "I was asleep but my heart was awake. A voice! My beloved was knocking: ‘Open to me, my sister, my darling, My dove, my perfect one! For my head is drenched with dew, My locks with the dew drops of the night.’
verses.textEn: I slept but my heart was awake. Listen! My beloved is knocking: "Open to me, my sister, my darling, my dove, my flawless one. My head is drenched with dew, my hair with the dampness of the night."

verses.textZh: 我回答："我脱了外衣， 怎能再穿上呢？ 我洗了脚， 怎能再弄脏呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我回答："我脱了外衣， 怎能再穿上呢？ 我洗了脚， 怎能再弄脏呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我回答说： 我脱了衣裳，怎能再穿上呢？ 我洗了脚，怎能再玷污呢？
verses.textEnNiv: I have taken off my robe— must I put it on again? I have washed my feet— must I soil them again?
verses.textEnEsv: I had put off my garment; how could I put it on? I had bathed my feet; how could I soil them?
verses.textEnNkjv: I have taken off my robe; How can I put it on again? I have washed my feet; How can I defile them?
verses.textEnNlt: But I responded, "I have taken off my robe. Should I get dressed again? I have washed my feet. Should I get them soiled?"
verses.textEnNasb: "I have taken off my dress, How can I put it on again? I have washed my feet, How can I dirty them again?
verses.textEn: I have taken off my robe— must I put it on again? I have washed my feet— must I soil them again?

verses.textZh: 我的良人从门孔里伸进手来， 我的心因他大为激动。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良人从门孔里伸进手来， 我的心因他大为激动。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的良人从门孔里伸进手来， 我便因他动了心。
verses.textEnNiv: My beloved thrust his hand through the latch-opening; my heart began to pound for him.
verses.textEnEsv: My beloved put his hand to the latch, and my heart was thrilled within me.
verses.textEnNkjv: My beloved put his hand By the latch ofthedoor, And my heart yearned for him.
verses.textEnNlt: My lover tried to unlatch the door, and my heart thrilled within me.
verses.textEnNasb: "My beloved extended his hand through the opening, And my feelings were stirred for him.
verses.textEn: My beloved thrust his hand through the latch-opening; my heart began to pound for him.

verses.textZh: 我起来，要给我的良人开门； 我的两手滴下没药， 指头滴下没药， 滴在门闩上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我起来，要给我的良人开门； 我的两手滴下没药， 指头滴下没药， 滴在门闩上。
verses.textZhCuv: 我起来，要给我良人开门。 我的两手滴下没药； 我的指头有没药汁滴在门闩上。
verses.textEnNiv: I arose to open for my beloved, and my hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with flowing myrrh, on the handles of the bolt.
verses.textEnEsv: I arose to open to my beloved, and my hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with liquid myrrh, on the handles of the bolt.
verses.textEnNkjv: I arose to open for my beloved, And my hands dripped with myrrh, My fingers with liquid myrrh, On the handles of the lock.
verses.textEnNlt: I jumped up to open the door for my love, and my hands dripped with perfume. My fingers dripped with lovely myrrh as I pulled back the bolt.
verses.textEnNasb: "I arose to open to my beloved; And my hands dripped with myrrh, And my fingers with drops of myrrh, On the handles of the bolt.
verses.textEn: I arose to open for my beloved, and my hands dripped with myrrh, my fingers with flowing myrrh, on the handles of the bolt.

verses.textZh: 我亲手给我的良人开门， 我的良人却已转身走了； 我发现他走了，差点昏倒； 我到处找他，却找不见， 我呼叫他，他却不回答。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我亲手给我的良人开门， 我的良人却已转身走了； 我发现他走了，差点昏倒； 我到处找他，却找不见， 我呼叫他，他却不回答。
verses.textZhCuv: 我给我的良人开了门； 我的良人却已转身走了。 他说话的时候，我神不守舍； 我寻找他，竟寻不见； 我呼叫他，他却不回答。
verses.textEnNiv: I opened for my beloved, but my beloved had left; he was gone. My heart sank at his departure. I looked for him but did not find him. I called him but he did not answer.
verses.textEnEsv: I opened to my beloved, but my beloved had turned and gone. My soul failed me when he spoke. I sought him, but found him not; I called him, but he gave no answer.
verses.textEnNkjv: I opened for my beloved, But my beloved had turned away and was gone. My heart leaped up when he spoke. I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.
verses.textEnNlt: I opened to my lover, but he was gone! My heart sank. I searched for him but could not find him anywhere. I called to him, but there was no reply.
verses.textEnNasb: "I opened to my beloved, But my beloved had turned away and had gone! My heart went out to him as he spoke. I searched for him but I did not find him; I called him but he did not answer me.
verses.textEn: I opened for my beloved, but my beloved had left; he was gone. My heart sank at his departure. I looked for him but did not find him. I called him but he did not answer.

verses.textZh: 城中的守卫巡逻的时候，找着我； 他们打了我，伤了我； 看守城墙的人夺去了我身上的外衣。
verses.textZhCnvs: 城中的守卫巡逻的时候，找着我； 他们打了我，伤了我； 看守城墙的人夺去了我身上的外衣。
verses.textZhCuv: 城中巡逻看守的人遇见我， 打了我，伤了我； 看守城墙的人夺去我的披肩。
verses.textEnNiv: The watchmen found me as they made their rounds in the city. They beat me, they bruised me; they took away my cloak, those watchmen of the walls!
verses.textEnEsv: The watchmen found me as they went about in the city; they beat me, they bruised me, they took away my veil, those watchmen of the walls.
verses.textEnNkjv: The watchmen who went about the city found me. They struck me, they wounded me; The keepers of the walls Took my veil away from me.
verses.textEnNlt: The night watchmen found me as they made their rounds. They beat and bruised me and stripped off my veil, those watchmen on the walls.
verses.textEnNasb: "The watchmen who make the rounds in the city found me, They struck me and wounded me; The guards of the walls took my shawl away from me.
verses.textEn: The watchmen found me as they made their rounds in the city. They beat me, they bruised me; they took away my cloak, those watchmen of the walls!

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！我嘱咐你们： 你们若遇见我的良人， 你们要告诉他甚么呢？ 你们要告诉他，我患了相思病。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！我嘱咐你们： 你们若遇见我的良人， 你们要告诉他甚么呢？ 你们要告诉他，我患了相思病。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊，我嘱咐你们： 若遇见我的良人， 要告诉他，我因思爱成病。 〔耶路撒冷的众女子〕
verses.textEnNiv: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you— if you find my beloved, what will you tell him? Tell him I am faint with love. Friends
verses.textEnEsv: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if you find my beloved, that you tell him I am sick with love. Others
verses.textEnNkjv: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, That you tell him I am lovesick! The Daughters of Jerusalem
verses.textEnNlt: Make this promise, O women of Jerusalem— If you find my lover, tell him I am weak with love. Young Women of Jerusalem
verses.textEnNasb: "Swear to me, you daughters of Jerusalem, If you find my beloved, As to what you will tell him: For I am lovesick." The Chorus
verses.textEn: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you— if you find my beloved, what will you tell him? Tell him I am faint with love. Friends

verses.textZh: 你这女子中最美丽的啊！ 你的良人比别人的良人有甚么更可爱之处呢？ 你的良人比别人的良人有甚么更可爱之处呢？ 以致你这样嘱咐我们呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这女子中最美丽的啊！ 你的良人比别人的良人有甚么更可爱之处呢？ 你的良人比别人的良人有甚么更可爱之处呢？ 以致你这样嘱咐我们呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 你这女子中极美丽的， 你的良人比别人的良人有何强处？ 你的良人比别人的良人有何强处， 你就这样嘱咐我们？ 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: How is your beloved better than others, most beautiful of women? How is your beloved better than others, that you so charge us? She
verses.textEnEsv: What is your beloved more than another beloved, O most beautiful among women? What is your beloved more than another beloved, that you thus adjure us? She
verses.textEnNkjv: What is your beloved More than another beloved, O fairest among women? What is your beloved More than another beloved, That you so charge us? The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: Why is your lover better than all others, O woman of rare beauty? What makes your lover so special that we must promise this? Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: " What kind of beloved is your beloved, O most beautiful among women? What kind of beloved is your beloved, That you make us swear in this way?" The Bride
verses.textEn: How is your beloved better than others, most beautiful of women? How is your beloved better than others, that you so charge us? She

verses.textZh: 我的良人红光满面， 是万人中的表表者。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良人红光满面， 是万人中的表表者。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的良人白而且红， 超乎万人之上。
verses.textEnNiv: My beloved is radiant and ruddy, outstanding among ten thousand.
verses.textEnEsv: My beloved is radiant and ruddy, distinguished among ten thousand.
verses.textEnNkjv: My beloved is white and ruddy, Chief among ten thousand.
verses.textEnNlt: My lover is dark and dazzling, better than ten thousand others!
verses.textEnNasb: "My beloved is dazzling and reddish, Outstanding among ten thousand.
verses.textEn: My beloved is radiant and ruddy, outstanding among ten thousand.

verses.textZh: 他的头像精金， 他的头发如棕树枝厚密， 像乌鸦那么黑。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的头像精金， 他的头发如棕树枝厚密， 像乌鸦那么黑。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的头像至精的金子； 他的头发厚密累垂，黑如乌鸦。
verses.textEnNiv: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy and black as a raven.
verses.textEnEsv: His head is the finest gold; his locks are wavy, black as a raven.
verses.textEnNkjv: His head islike the finest gold; His locks are wavy, And black as a raven.
verses.textEnNlt: His head is finest gold, his wavy hair is black as a raven.
verses.textEnNasb: "His head is like gold, pure gold; His locks are like clusters of dates And black as a raven.
verses.textEn: His head is purest gold; his hair is wavy and black as a raven.

verses.textZh: 他的眼好象溪水旁的鸽子， 在奶中洗净，塑得合式。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的眼好象溪水旁的鸽子， 在奶中洗净，塑得合式。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的眼如溪水旁的鸽子眼， 用奶洗净，安得合式。
verses.textEnNiv: His eyes are like doves by the water streams, washed in milk, mounted like jewels.
verses.textEnEsv: His eyes are like doves beside streams of water, bathed in milk, sitting beside a full pool.
verses.textEnNkjv: His eyes are like doves By the rivers of waters, Washed with milk, And fitly set.
verses.textEnNlt: His eyes sparkle like doves beside springs of water; they are set like jewels washed in milk.
verses.textEnNasb: "His eyes are like doves Beside streams of water, Bathed in milk, And perched in their setting.
verses.textEn: His eyes are like doves by the water streams, washed in milk, mounted like jewels.

verses.textZh: 他的两颊如香花畦， 又如香草台； 他的嘴唇像百合花， 滴下没药汁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的两颊如香花畦， 又如香草台； 他的嘴唇像百合花， 滴下没药汁。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的两腮如香花畦， 如香草台； 他的嘴唇像百合花， 且滴下没药汁。
verses.textEnNiv: His cheeks are like beds of spice yielding perfume. His lips are like lilies dripping with myrrh.
verses.textEnEsv: His cheeks are like beds of spices, mounds of sweet-smelling herbs. His lips are lilies, dripping liquid myrrh.
verses.textEnNkjv: His cheeks are like a bed of spices, Banks of scented herbs. His lips are lilies, Dripping liquid myrrh.
verses.textEnNlt: His cheeks are like gardens of spices giving off fragrance. His lips are like lilies, perfumed with myrrh.
verses.textEnNasb: "His cheeks are like a bed of balsam, Banks of herbal spices; His lips are lilies Dripping with drops of myrrh.
verses.textEn: His cheeks are like beds of spice yielding perfume. His lips are like lilies dripping with myrrh.

verses.textZh: 他的双手像金管， 镶嵌着水苍玉； 他的躯体如象牙块， 周围包着蓝宝石。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的双手像金管， 镶嵌着水苍玉； 他的躯体如象牙块， 周围包着蓝宝石。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的两手好像金管， 镶嵌水苍玉； 他的身体如同雕刻的象牙， 周围镶嵌蓝宝石。
verses.textEnNiv: His arms are rods of gold set with topaz. His body is like polished ivory decorated with lapis lazuli.
verses.textEnEsv: His arms are rods of gold, set with jewels. His body is polished ivory, bedecked with sapphires.
verses.textEnNkjv: His hands are rods of gold Set with beryl. His body is carved ivory Inlaid with sapphires.
verses.textEnNlt: His arms are like rounded bars of gold, set with beryl. His body is like bright ivory, glowing with lapis lazuli.
verses.textEnNasb: "His hands are rods of gold Set with topaz; His abdomen is panels of ivory Covered with sapphires.
verses.textEn: His arms are rods of gold set with topaz. His body is like polished ivory decorated with lapis lazuli.

verses.textZh: 他的双腿像大理石柱， 安放在精金的座上； 他的容貌如黎巴嫩山， 像佳美的香柏树。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的双腿像大理石柱， 安放在精金的座上； 他的容貌如黎巴嫩山， 像佳美的香柏树。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的腿好像白玉石柱， 安在精金座上； 他的形状如黎巴嫩， 且佳美如香柏树。
verses.textEnNiv: His legs are pillars of marble set on bases of pure gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, choice as its cedars.
verses.textEnEsv: His legs are alabaster columns, set on bases of gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, choice as the cedars.
verses.textEnNkjv: His legs are pillars of marble Set on bases of fine gold. His countenance is like Lebanon, Excellent as the cedars.
verses.textEnNlt: His legs are like marble pillars set in sockets of finest gold. His posture is stately, like the noble cedars of Lebanon.
verses.textEnNasb: "His thighs are pillars of alabaster Set on pedestals of pure gold; His appearance is like Lebanon, Choice as the cedars.
verses.textEn: His legs are pillars of marble set on bases of pure gold. His appearance is like Lebanon, choice as its cedars.

verses.textZh: 他的口甜蜜； 他全然可爱。 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！ 这就是我的良人，我的朋友。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的口甜蜜； 他全然可爱。 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！ 这就是我的良人，我的朋友。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的口极其甘甜； 他全然可爱。 耶路撒冷的众女子啊， 这是我的良人； 这是我的朋友。
verses.textEnNiv: His mouth is sweetness itself; he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: His mouth is most sweet, and he is altogether desirable. This is my beloved and this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: His mouth is most sweet, Yes, he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, And this is my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem!
verses.textEnNlt: His mouth is sweetness itself; he is desirable in every way. Such, O women of Jerusalem, is my lover, my friend.
verses.textEnNasb: "His mouth is full of sweetness. And he is wholly desirable. This is my beloved and this is my friend, You daughters of Jerusalem."
verses.textEn: His mouth is sweetness itself; he is altogether lovely. This is my beloved, this is my friend, daughters of Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 你这女子中极美丽的啊！ 你的良人到哪里去了？ 你的良人转到哪里去了？ 让我们与你去寻找他吧！
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这女子中极美丽的啊！ 你的良人到哪里去了？ 你的良人转到哪里去了？ 让我们与你去寻找他吧！
verses.textZhCuv: 你这女子中极美丽的， 你的良人往何处去了？ 你的良人转向何处去了， 我们好与你同去寻找他。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: Where has your beloved gone, most beautiful of women? Which way did your beloved turn, that we may look for him with you? She
verses.textEnEsv: Where has your beloved gone, O most beautiful among women? Where has your beloved turned, that we may seek him with you? She
verses.textEnNkjv: Where has your beloved gone, O fairest among women? Where has your beloved turned aside, That we may seek him with you? The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: Where has your lover gone, O woman of rare beauty? Which way did he turn so we can help you find him? Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: "Where has your beloved gone, O most beautiful among women? Where has your beloved turned, That we may seek him with you?" The Bride
verses.textEn: Where has your beloved gone, most beautiful of women? Which way did your beloved turn, that we may look for him with you? She

verses.textZh: 我的良人下到自己的园中， 下到香花畦那里， 在园内细赏， 采摘百合花。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良人下到自己的园中， 下到香花畦那里， 在园内细赏， 采摘百合花。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的良人下入自己园中， 到香花畦， 在园内牧放群羊， 采百合花。
verses.textEnNiv: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to browse in the gardens and to gather lilies.
verses.textEnEsv: My beloved has gone down to his garden to the beds of spices, to graze in the gardens and to gather lilies.
verses.textEnNkjv: My beloved has gone to his garden, To the beds of spices, To feed hisflock in the gardens, And to gather lilies.
verses.textEnNlt: My lover has gone down to his garden, to his spice beds, to browse in the gardens and gather the lilies.
verses.textEnNasb: "My beloved has gone down to his garden, To the beds of balsam, To pasture his flock in the gardens And gather lilies.
verses.textEn: My beloved has gone down to his garden, to the beds of spices, to browse in the gardens and to gather lilies.

verses.textZh: 我属我的良人，我的良人也属我； 他在百合花中细赏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我属我的良人，我的良人也属我； 他在百合花中细赏。
verses.textZhCuv: 我属我的良人， 我的良人也属我； 他在百合花中牧放群羊。 〔新郎〕
verses.textEnNiv: I am my beloved’s and my beloved is mine; he browses among the lilies. He
verses.textEnEsv: I am my beloved’s and my beloved is mine; he grazes among the lilies. He
verses.textEnNkjv: I am my beloved’s, And my beloved is mine. He feeds hisflock among the lilies. The Beloved
verses.textEnNlt: I am my lover’s, and my lover is mine. He browses among the lilies. Young Man
verses.textEnNasb: "I am my beloved’s and my beloved is mine, He who pastures his flock among the lilies." The Groom
verses.textEn: I am my beloved’s and my beloved is mine; he browses among the lilies. He

verses.textZh: 我的佳偶啊！你美丽如得撒， 秀丽如耶路撒冷， 威武如展开旗帜的军队。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的佳偶啊！你美丽如得撒， 秀丽如耶路撒冷， 威武如展开旗帜的军队。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的佳偶啊，你美丽如得撒， 秀美如耶路撒冷， 威武如展开旌旗的军队。
verses.textEnNiv: You are as beautiful as Tirzah, my darling, as lovely as Jerusalem, as majestic as troops with banners.
verses.textEnEsv: You are beautiful as Tirzah, my love, lovely as Jerusalem, awesome as an army with banners.
verses.textEnNkjv: O my love, you areas beautiful as Tirzah, Lovely as Jerusalem, Awesome as anarmy with banners!
verses.textEnNlt: You are beautiful, my darling, like the lovely city of Tirzah. Yes, as beautiful as Jerusalem, as majestic as an army with billowing banners.
verses.textEnNasb: "You are as beautiful as Tirzah, my darling, As lovely as Jerusalem, As awesome as an army with banners.
verses.textEn: You are as beautiful as Tirzah, my darling, as lovely as Jerusalem, as majestic as troops with banners.

verses.textZh: 请你转眼不要看我， 因为你的眼使我心动！ 你的头发如同从基列山下来的山羊群。
verses.textZhCnvs: 请你转眼不要看我， 因为你的眼使我心动！ 你的头发如同从基列山下来的山羊群。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你掉转眼目不看我， 因你的眼目使我惊乱。 你的头发如同山羊群卧在基列山旁。
verses.textEnNiv: Turn your eyes from me; they overwhelm me. Your hair is like a flock of goats descending from Gilead.
verses.textEnEsv: Turn away your eyes from me, for they overwhelm me— Your hair is like a flock of goats leaping down the slopes of Gilead.
verses.textEnNkjv: Turn your eyes away from me, For they have overcome me. Your hair is like a flock of goats Going down from Gilead.
verses.textEnNlt: Turn your eyes away, for they overpower me. Your hair falls in waves, like a flock of goats winding down the slopes of Gilead.
verses.textEnNasb: "Turn your eyes away from me, For they have confused me; Your hair is like a flock of goats That have descended from Gilead.
verses.textEn: Turn your eyes from me; they overwhelm me. Your hair is like a flock of goats descending from Gilead.

verses.textZh: 你的牙齿像一群母羊， 刚刚洗净上来那样洁白整齐； 牠们成双成对， 没有单独一只的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的牙齿像一群母羊， 刚刚洗净上来那样洁白整齐； 牠们成双成对， 没有单独一只的。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的牙齿如一群母羊 洗净上来，个个都有双生， 没有一只丧掉子的。
