verses.textEnNiv: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep coming up from the washing. Each has its twin, not one of them is missing.
verses.textEnEsv: Your teeth are like a flock of ewes that have come up from the washing; all of them bear twins; not one among them has lost its young.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep Which have come up from the washing; Every one bears twins, And none is barren among them.
verses.textEnNlt: Your teeth are as white as sheep that are freshly washed. Your smile is flawless, each tooth matched with its twin.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your teeth are like a flock of ewes That have come up from their watering place, All of which bear twins, And not one among them has lost her young.
verses.textEn: Your teeth are like a flock of sheep coming up from the washing. Each has its twin, not one of them is missing.

verses.textZh: 你的两颊在面纱后面， 如同切开的石榴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的两颊在面纱后面， 如同切开的石榴。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的两太阳在帕子内， 如同一块石榴。
verses.textEnNiv: Your temples behind your veil are like the halves of a pomegranate.
verses.textEnEsv: Your cheeks are like halves of a pomegranate behind your veil.
verses.textEnNkjv: Like a piece of pomegranate Are your temples behind your veil.
verses.textEnNlt: Your cheeks are like rosy pomegranates behind your veil.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your temples are like a slice of a pomegranate Behind your veil.
verses.textEn: Your temples behind your veil are like the halves of a pomegranate.

verses.textZh: 虽有六十位王后，八十位妃嫔， 并有无数的宫女；
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽有六十位王后，八十位妃嫔， 并有无数的宫女；
verses.textZhCuv: 有六十王后八十妃嫔， 并有无数的童女。
verses.textEnNiv: Sixty queens there may be, and eighty concubines, and virgins beyond number;
verses.textEnEsv: There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, and virgins without number.
verses.textEnNkjv: There are sixty queens And eighty concubines, And virgins without number.
verses.textEnNlt: Even among sixty queens and eighty concubines and countless young women,
verses.textEnNasb: "There are sixty queens and eighty concubines, And young women without number;
verses.textEn: Sixty queens there may be, and eighty concubines, and virgins beyond number;

verses.textZh: 唯独我的鸽子，我的完全人，是独一的； 是她母亲独一的宝贝， 是生养她者的宠儿。 众女子看见她，都称她为有福； 王后妃嫔见了，也都赞赏她，说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 唯独我的鸽子，我的完全人，是独一的； 是她母亲独一的宝贝， 是生养她者的宠儿。 众女子看见她，都称她为有福； 王后妃嫔见了，也都赞赏她，说：
verses.textZhCuv: 我的鸽子，我的完全人， 只有这一个是她母亲独生的， 是生养她者所宝爱的。 众女子见了就称她有福； 王后妃嫔见了也赞美她。
verses.textEnNiv: but my dove, my perfect one, is unique, the only daughter of her mother, the favorite of the one who bore her. The young women saw her and called her blessed; the queens and concubines praised her. Friends
verses.textEnEsv: My dove, my perfect one, is the only one, the only one of her mother, pure to her who bore her. The young women saw her and called her blessed; the queens and concubines also, and they praised her.
verses.textEnNkjv: My dove, my perfect one, Is the only one, The only one of her mother, The favorite of the one who bore her. The daughters saw her And called her blessed, The queens and the concubines, And they praised her.
verses.textEnNlt: I would still choose my dove, my perfect one— the favorite of her mother, dearly loved by the one who bore her. The young women see her and praise her; even queens and royal concubines sing her praises:
verses.textEnNasb: But my dove, my perfect one, is unique: She is her mother’s only daughter; She is the pure child of the one who gave birth to her. The young women saw her and called her blessed, The queens and the concubines also, and they praised her, saying,
verses.textEn: but my dove, my perfect one, is unique, the only daughter of her mother, the favorite of the one who bore her. The young women saw her and called her blessed; the queens and concubines praised her. Friends

verses.textZh: "那出现如破晓的晨光， 美丽如月亮， 灿烂如日头， 威武有如展开旗帜的军队的是谁呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: "那出现如破晓的晨光， 美丽如月亮， 灿烂如日头， 威武有如展开旗帜的军队的是谁呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 那向外观看、如晨光发现、 美丽如月亮、皎洁如日头、 威武如展开旌旗军队的是谁呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Who is this that appears like the dawn, fair as the moon, bright as the sun, majestic as the stars in procession? He
verses.textEnEsv: "Who is this who looks down like the dawn, beautiful as the moon, bright as the sun, awesome as an army with banners?" She
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is she who looks forth as the morning, Fair as the moon, Clear as the sun, Awesome as anarmy with banners? The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: "Who is this, arising like the dawn, as fair as the moon, as bright as the sun, as majestic as an army with billowing banners?" Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Who is this who looks down like the dawn, As beautiful as the full moon, As pure as the sun, As awesome as an army with banners?’
verses.textEn: Who is this that appears like the dawn, fair as the moon, bright as the sun, majestic as the stars in procession? He

verses.textZh: 我下到核桃园去， 看看谷中青绿的植物， 看看葡萄树发芽没有， 石榴树开花没有；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我下到核桃园去， 看看谷中青绿的植物， 看看葡萄树发芽没有， 石榴树开花没有；
verses.textZhCuv: 我下入核桃园， 要看谷中青绿的植物， 要看葡萄发芽没有， 石榴开花没有。
verses.textEnNiv: I went down to the grove of nut trees to look at the new growth in the valley, to see if the vines had budded or the pomegranates were in bloom.
verses.textEnEsv: I went down to the nut orchard to look at the blossoms of the valley, to see whether the vines had budded, whether the pomegranates were in bloom.
verses.textEnNkjv: I went down to the garden of nuts To see the verdure of the valley, To see whether the vine had budded And the pomegranates had bloomed.
verses.textEnNlt: I went down to the grove of walnut trees and out to the valley to see the new spring growth, to see whether the grapevines had budded or the pomegranates were in bloom.
verses.textEnNasb: "I went down to the orchard of nut trees To see the plants of the valley, To see whether the vine had grown Or the pomegranates had bloomed.
verses.textEn: I went down to the grove of nut trees to look at the new growth in the valley, to see if the vines had budded or the pomegranates were in bloom.

verses.textZh: 不知不觉之间，我的心 把我置于我尊贵的民的车中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 不知不觉之间，我的心 把我置于我尊贵的民的车中。
verses.textZhCuv: 不知不觉， 我的心将我安置在我尊长的车中。 〔耶路撒冷的众女子〕
verses.textEnNiv: Before I realized it, my desire set me among the royal chariots of my people. Friends
verses.textEnEsv: Before I was aware, my desire set me among the chariots of my kinsman, a prince. Others
verses.textEnNkjv: Before I was even aware, My soul had made me As the chariots of my noble people. The Beloved and His Friends
verses.textEnNlt: Before I realized it, my strong desires had taken me to the chariot of a noble man. Young Women of Jerusalem
verses.textEnNasb: " Before I was aware, my soul set me Over the chariots of my noble people." The Chorus
verses.textEn: Before I realized it, my desire set me among the royal chariots of my people. Friends

verses.textZh: 回来吧，回来吧，书拉密女啊！ 回来吧，回来吧，让我们看看你。 你们为甚么要看书拉密女， 像看两队兵跳舞呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 回来吧，回来吧，书拉密女啊！ 回来吧，回来吧，让我们看看你。 你们为甚么要看书拉密女， 像看两队兵跳舞呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 回来，回来，书拉密女； 你回来，你回来，使我们得观看你。 〔新娘〕 你们为何要观看书拉密女， 像观看玛哈念跳舞的呢？
verses.textEnNiv: Come back, come back, O Shulammite; come back, come back, that we may gaze on you! He Why would you gaze on the Shulammite as on the dance of Mahanaim?
verses.textEnEsv: Return, return, O Shulammite, return, return, that we may look upon you. He Why should you look upon the Shulammite, as upon a dance before two armies?
verses.textEnNkjv: Return, return, O Shulamite; Return, return, that we may look upon you! The Shulamite What would you see in the Shulamite— As it were, the dance of the two camps?
verses.textEnNlt: Return, return to us, O maid of Shulam. Come back, come back, that we may see you again. Young Man Why do you stare at this young woman of Shulam, as she moves so gracefully between two lines of dancers?
verses.textEnNasb: " Come back, come back, O Shulammite; Come back, come back, so that we may look at you!" The Groom "Why should you look at the Shulammite, As at the dance of the two armies?
verses.textEn: Come back, come back, O Shulammite; come back, come back, that we may gaze on you! He Why would you gaze on the Shulammite as on the dance of Mahanaim?

verses.textZh: 王女啊！ 你的脚在鞋中多么美丽； 你大腿的曲线美如珠玉， 是巧匠手里的杰作。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王女啊！ 你的脚在鞋中多么美丽； 你大腿的曲线美如珠玉， 是巧匠手里的杰作。
verses.textZhCuv: 王女啊，你的脚在鞋中何其美好！ 你的大腿圆润，好像美玉， 是巧匠的手做成的。
verses.textEnNiv: How beautiful your sandaled feet, O prince’s daughter! Your graceful legs are like jewels, the work of an artist’s hands.
verses.textEnEsv: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, O noble daughter! Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of a master hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: How beautiful are your feet in sandals, O prince’s daughter! The curves of your thighs are like jewels, The work of the hands of a skillful workman.
verses.textEnNlt: How beautiful are your sandaled feet, O queenly maiden. Your rounded thighs are like jewels, the work of a skilled craftsman.
verses.textEnNasb: " How beautiful are your feet in sandals, Prince’s daughter! The curves of your hips are like jewels, The work of the hands of an artist.
verses.textEn: How beautiful your sandaled feet, O prince’s daughter! Your graceful legs are like jewels, the work of an artist’s hands.

verses.textZh: 你的肚脐如圆杯， 永不缺乏调和的酒； 你的肚腹像一堆麦子， 周围有百合花。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的肚脐如圆杯， 永不缺乏调和的酒； 你的肚腹像一堆麦子， 周围有百合花。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的肚脐如圆杯， 不缺调和的酒； 你的腰如一堆麦子， 周围有百合花。
verses.textEnNiv: Your navel is a rounded goblet that never lacks blended wine. Your waist is a mound of wheat encircled by lilies.
verses.textEnEsv: Your navel is a rounded bowl that never lacks mixed wine. Your belly is a heap of wheat, encircled with lilies.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your navel is a rounded goblet; It lacks no blended beverage. Your waist is a heap of wheat Set about with lilies.
verses.textEnNlt: Your navel is perfectly formed like a goblet filled with mixed wine. Between your thighs lies a mound of wheat bordered with lilies.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your navel is like a round goblet That never lacks mixed wine; Your belly is like a heap of wheat, Surrounded with lilies.
verses.textEn: Your navel is a rounded goblet that never lacks blended wine. Your waist is a mound of wheat encircled by lilies.

verses.textZh: 你的两乳像一对小鹿， 像双生的母羚羊。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的两乳像一对小鹿， 像双生的母羚羊。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的两乳好像一对小鹿， 就是母鹿双生的。
verses.textEnNiv: Your breasts are like two fawns, like twin fawns of a gazelle.
verses.textEnEsv: Your two breasts are like two fawns, twins of a gazelle.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your two breasts are like two fawns, Twins of a gazelle.
verses.textEnNlt: Your breasts are like two fawns, twin fawns of a gazelle.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your two breasts are like two fawns, Twins of a gazelle.
verses.textEn: Your breasts are like two fawns, like twin fawns of a gazelle.

verses.textZh: 你的颈项如象牙塔； 你的眼像希实本城内， 巴特．拉并门旁的水池； 你的鼻子好象黎巴嫩的高塔， 居高临下朝着大马士革。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的颈项如象牙塔； 你的眼像希实本城内， 巴特．拉并门旁的水池； 你的鼻子好象黎巴嫩的高塔， 居高临下朝着大马士革。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的颈项如象牙台； 你的眼目像希实本、巴特‧拉并门旁的水池； 你的鼻子仿佛朝大马士革的黎巴嫩塔。
verses.textEnNiv: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath Rabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon looking toward Damascus.
verses.textEnEsv: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are pools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bath-rabbim. Your nose is like a tower of Lebanon, which looks toward Damascus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your neck is like an ivory tower, Your eyes like the pools in Heshbon By the gate of Bath Rabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon Which looks toward Damascus.
verses.textEnNlt: Your neck is as beautiful as an ivory tower. Your eyes are like the sparkling pools in Heshbon by the gate of Bath-rabbim. Your nose is as fine as the tower of Lebanon overlooking Damascus.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your neck is like a tower of ivory, Your eyes like the pools in Heshbon By the gate of Bath-rabbim; Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon, Which looks toward Damascus.
verses.textEn: Your neck is like an ivory tower. Your eyes are the pools of Heshbon by the gate of Bath Rabbim. Your nose is like the tower of Lebanon looking toward Damascus.

verses.textZh: 你的头在你身上像迦密山； 你头上的秀发是紫黑色的； 君王的心竟给这些发绺系住了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的头在你身上像迦密山； 你头上的秀发是紫黑色的； 君王的心竟给这些发绺系住了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的头在你身上好像迦密山； 你头上的发是紫黑色； 王的心因这下垂的发绺系住了。
verses.textEnNiv: Your head crowns you like Mount Carmel. Your hair is like royal tapestry; the king is held captive by its tresses.
verses.textEnEsv: Your head crowns you like Carmel, and your flowing locks are like purple; a king is held captive in the tresses.
verses.textEnNkjv: Your head crowns you like Mount Carmel, And the hair of your head is like purple; A king is held captive by your tresses.
verses.textEnNlt: Your head is as majestic as Mount Carmel, and the sheen of your hair radiates royalty. The king is held captive by its tresses.
verses.textEnNasb: "Your head crowns you like Carmel, And the flowing hair of your head is like purple threads; The king is captivated by your tresses.
verses.textEn: Your head crowns you like Mount Carmel. Your hair is like royal tapestry; the king is held captive by its tresses.

verses.textZh: 亲爱的啊！使人喜悦的啊！ 你多么美丽，多么可爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 亲爱的啊！使人喜悦的啊！ 你多么美丽，多么可爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 我所爱的，你何其美好！ 何其可悦，使人欢畅喜乐！
verses.textEnNiv: How beautiful you are and how pleasing, my love, with your delights!
verses.textEnEsv: How beautiful and pleasant you are, O loved one, with all your delights!
verses.textEnNkjv: How fair and how pleasant you are, O love, with your delights!
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, how beautiful you are! How pleasing, my love, how full of delights!
verses.textEnNasb: "How beautiful and how delightful you are, My love, with all your delights!
verses.textEn: How beautiful you are and how pleasing, my love, with your delights!

verses.textZh: 你的身量像一棵棕树； 你的两乳如树上累累的果子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的身量像一棵棕树； 你的两乳如树上累累的果子。
verses.textZhCuv: 你的身量好像棕树； 你的两乳如同其上的果子，累累下垂。
verses.textEnNiv: Your stature is like that of the palm, and your breasts like clusters of fruit.
verses.textEnEsv: Your stature is like a palm tree, and your breasts are like its clusters.
verses.textEnNkjv: This stature of yours is like a palm tree, And your breasts like its clusters.
verses.textEnNlt: You are slender like a palm tree, and your breasts are like its clusters of fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: " Your stature is like a palm tree, And your breasts are like its clusters.
verses.textEn: Your stature is like that of the palm, and your breasts like clusters of fruit.

verses.textZh: 我说："我要爬上这棵棕树， 我要抓住它的果子。" 愿你的两乳如一挂一挂的葡萄串； 你鼻子的香气如苹果芬芳；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我说："我要爬上这棵棕树， 我要抓住它的果子。" 愿你的两乳如一挂一挂的葡萄串； 你鼻子的香气如苹果芬芳；
verses.textZhCuv: 我说：我要上这棕树，抓住枝子。 愿你的两乳好像葡萄累累下垂， 你鼻子的气味香如苹果；
verses.textEnNiv: I said, "I will climb the palm tree; I will take hold of its fruit." May your breasts be like clusters of grapes on the vine, the fragrance of your breath like apples,
verses.textEnEsv: I say I will climb the palm tree and lay hold of its fruit. Oh may your breasts be like clusters of the vine, and the scent of your breath like apples,
verses.textEnNkjv: I said, "I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of its branches." Let now your breasts be like clusters of the vine, The fragrance of your breath like apples,
verses.textEnNlt: I said, "I will climb the palm tree and take hold of its fruit." May your breasts be like grape clusters, and the fragrance of your breath like apples.
verses.textEnNasb: "I said, ‘I will climb the palm tree, I will grasp its fruit stalks.’ Oh, may your breasts be like clusters of the vine, And the fragrance of your breath like apples,
verses.textEn: I said, "I will climb the palm tree; I will take hold of its fruit." May your breasts be like clusters of grapes on the vine, the fragrance of your breath like apples,

verses.textZh: 你的口像美酒。 书拉密女说："直流入我良人的口里， 轻轻流过唇齿之间 。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你的口像美酒。 书拉密女说："直流入我良人的口里， 轻轻流过唇齿之间 。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你的口如上好的酒。 〔新娘〕 女子说：为我的良人下咽舒畅， 流入睡觉人的嘴中。
verses.textEnNiv: and your mouth like the best wine. She May the wine go straight to my beloved, flowing gently over lips and teeth.
verses.textEnEsv: and your mouth like the best wine. She It goes down smoothly for my beloved, gliding over lips and teeth.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the roof of your mouth like the best wine. The Shulamite Thewine goes down smoothly for my beloved, Moving gently the lips of sleepers.
verses.textEnNlt: May your kisses be as exciting as the best wine— Young Woman Yes, wine that goes down smoothly for my lover, flowing gently over lips and teeth.
verses.textEnNasb: And your mouth like the best wine!" The Bride "It goes down smoothly for my beloved, Flowing gently through the lips of those who are asleep.
verses.textEn: and your mouth like the best wine. She May the wine go straight to my beloved, flowing gently over lips and teeth.

verses.textZh: 我属我的良人， 他也恋慕我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我属我的良人， 他也恋慕我。
verses.textZhCuv: 我属我的良人， 他也恋慕我。
verses.textEnNiv: I belong to my beloved, and his desire is for me.
verses.textEnEsv: I am my beloved’s, and his desire is for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am my beloved’s, And his desire is toward me.
verses.textEnNlt: I am my lover’s, and he claims me as his own.
verses.textEnNasb: "I am my beloved’s, And his desire is for me.
verses.textEn: I belong to my beloved, and his desire is for me.

verses.textZh: 我的良人哪！来吧！让我们往田间去； 让我们在凤仙花丛中过夜吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良人哪！来吧！让我们往田间去； 让我们在凤仙花丛中过夜吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的良人，来吧！ 你我可以往田间去； 你我可以在村庄住宿。
verses.textEnNiv: Come, my beloved, let us go to the countryside, let us spend the night in the villages.
verses.textEnEsv: Come, my beloved, let us go out into the fields and lodge in the villages;
verses.textEnNkjv: Come, my beloved, Let us go forth to the field; Let us lodge in the villages.
verses.textEnNlt: Come, my love, let us go out to the fields and spend the night among the wildflowers.
verses.textEnNasb: "Come, my beloved, let’s go out to the country, Let’s spend the night in the villages.
verses.textEn: Come, my beloved, let us go to the countryside, let us spend the night in the villages.

verses.textZh: 我们早晨起来往葡萄园去， 去看葡萄树发芽没有， 花朵开放没有； 也看看石榴开花没有。 我在那里要把我的爱给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们早晨起来往葡萄园去， 去看葡萄树发芽没有， 花朵开放没有； 也看看石榴开花没有。 我在那里要把我的爱给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们早晨起来往葡萄园去， 看看葡萄发芽开花没有， 石榴放蕊没有； 我在那里要将我的爱情给你。
verses.textEnNiv: Let us go early to the vineyards to see if the vines have budded, if their blossoms have opened, and if the pomegranates are in bloom— there I will give you my love.
verses.textEnEsv: let us go out early to the vineyards and see whether the vines have budded, whether the grape blossoms have opened and the pomegranates are in bloom. There I will give you my love.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let us get up early to the vineyards; Let us see if the vine has budded, Whether the grape blossoms are open, And the pomegranates are in bloom. There I will give you my love.
verses.textEnNlt: Let us get up early and go to the vineyards to see if the grapevines have budded, if the blossoms have opened, and if the pomegranates have bloomed. There I will give you my love.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let’s rise early and go to the vineyards; Let’s see whether the vine has grown And its buds have opened, And whether the pomegranates have bloomed. There I will give you my love.
verses.textEn: Let us go early to the vineyards to see if the vines have budded, if their blossoms have opened, and if the pomegranates are in bloom— there I will give you my love.

verses.textZh: 风茄正在散发香气； 在我们的门旁有各样佳美的果子， 新的旧的都有。 我的良人哪，这些都是我为你保存的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 风茄正在散发香气； 在我们的门旁有各样佳美的果子， 新的旧的都有。 我的良人哪，这些都是我为你保存的。
verses.textZhCuv: 风茄放香， 在我们的门内有各样新陈佳美的果子； 我的良人，这都是我为你存留的。
verses.textEnNiv: The mandrakes send out their fragrance, and at our door is every delicacy, both new and old, that I have stored up for you, my beloved.
verses.textEnEsv: The mandrakes give forth fragrance, and beside our doors are all choice fruits, new as well as old, which I have laid up for you, O my beloved.
verses.textEnNkjv: The mandrakes give off a fragrance, And at our gates are pleasant fruits, All manner, new and old, Which I have laid up for you, my beloved.
verses.textEnNlt: There the mandrakes give off their fragrance, and the finest fruits are at our door, new delights as well as old, which I have saved for you, my lover.
verses.textEnNasb: "The mandrakes have given forth fragrance; And over our doors are all delicious fruits, New as well as old, Which I have saved for you, my beloved.
verses.textEn: The mandrakes send out their fragrance, and at our door is every delicacy, both new and old, that I have stored up for you, my beloved.

verses.textZh: 但愿你像我的兄弟， 像吃我母亲奶的兄弟。 这样，我在外面遇见你，就可以吻你， 不会被人藐视。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但愿你像我的兄弟， 像吃我母亲奶的兄弟。 这样，我在外面遇见你，就可以吻你， 不会被人藐视。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴不得你像我的兄弟， 像吃我母亲奶的兄弟； 我在外头遇见你就与你亲嘴， 谁也不轻看我。
verses.textEnNiv: If only you were to me like a brother, who was nursed at my mother’s breasts! Then, if I found you outside, I would kiss you, and no one would despise me.
verses.textEnEsv: Oh that you were like a brother to me who nursed at my mother’s breasts! If I found you outside, I would kiss you, and none would despise me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Oh, that you were like my brother, Who nursed at my mother’s breasts! If I should find you outside, I would kiss you; I would not be despised.
verses.textEnNlt: Oh, I wish you were my brother, who nursed at my mother’s breasts. Then I could kiss you no matter who was watching, and no one would criticize me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Oh that you were like a brother to me Who nursed at my mother’s breasts. If I found you outdoors, I would kiss you; No one would despise me, either.
verses.textEn: If only you were to me like a brother, who was nursed at my mother’s breasts! Then, if I found you outside, I would kiss you, and no one would despise me.

verses.textZh: 我要引领你， 领你到我母亲家里去；从小她就教导我。 我要给你喝石榴汁酿的香酒。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我要引领你， 领你到我母亲家里去；从小她就教导我。 我要给你喝石榴汁酿的香酒。
verses.textZhCuv: 我必引导你， 领你进我母亲的家； 我可以领受教训， 也就使你喝石榴汁酿的香酒。
verses.textEnNiv: I would lead you and bring you to my mother’s house— she who has taught me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the nectar of my pomegranates.
verses.textEnEsv: I would lead you and bring you into the house of my mother— she who used to teach me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the juice of my pomegranate.
verses.textEnNkjv: I would lead you and bring you Into the house of my mother, She who used to instruct me. I would cause you to drink of spiced wine, Of the juice of my pomegranate. (To the Daughters of Jerusalem)
verses.textEnNlt: I would bring you to my childhood home, and there you would teach me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, my sweet pomegranate wine.
verses.textEnNasb: "I would lead you and bring you Into the house of my mother, who used to instruct me; I would give you spiced wine to drink from the juice of my pomegranates.
verses.textEn: I would lead you and bring you to my mother’s house— she who has taught me. I would give you spiced wine to drink, the nectar of my pomegranates.

verses.textZh: 他的左手托住我的头， 他的右手拥抱着我。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的左手托住我的头， 他的右手拥抱着我。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的左手必在我头下； 他的右手必将我抱住。
verses.textEnNiv: His left arm is under my head and his right arm embraces me.
verses.textEnEsv: His left hand is under my head, and his right hand embraces me!
verses.textEnNkjv: His left hand is under my head, And his right hand embraces me.
verses.textEnNlt: Your left arm would be under my head, and your right arm would embrace me.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let his left hand be under my head, And his right hand embrace me." The Groom
verses.textEn: His left arm is under my head and his right arm embraces me.

verses.textZh: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！我恳求你们， 不要激动，不要挑动爱情， 等它自发吧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊！我恳求你们， 不要激动，不要挑动爱情， 等它自发吧。
verses.textZhCuv: 耶路撒冷的众女子啊， 我嘱咐你们： 不要惊动、不要叫醒我所亲爱的， 等他自己情愿 。 〔耶路撒冷的众女子〕
verses.textEnNiv: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires. Friends
verses.textEnEsv: I adjure you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up or awaken love until it pleases.
verses.textEnNkjv: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, Do not stir up nor awaken love Until it pleases. A Relative
verses.textEnNlt: Promise me, O women of Jerusalem, not to awaken love until the time is right. Young Women of Jerusalem
verses.textEnNasb: "Swear to me, you daughters of Jerusalem: Do not disturb or awaken my love Until she pleases." The Chorus
verses.textEn: Daughters of Jerusalem, I charge you: Do not arouse or awaken love until it so desires. Friends

verses.textZh: 那从旷野上来， 靠在她爱人身旁的是谁呢？ 我在苹果树下唤醒了你； 在那里你的母亲怀了你； 在那里生育你的为你受生产的痛苦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那从旷野上来， 靠在她爱人身旁的是谁呢？ 我在苹果树下唤醒了你； 在那里你的母亲怀了你； 在那里生育你的为你受生产的痛苦。
verses.textZhCuv: 那靠着良人从旷野上来的是谁呢？ 〔新娘〕 我在苹果树下叫醒你。 你母亲在那里为你劬劳； 生养你的在那里为你劬劳。
verses.textEnNiv: Who is this coming up from the wilderness leaning on her beloved? She Under the apple tree I roused you; there your mother conceived you, there she who was in labor gave you birth.
verses.textEnEsv: Who is that coming up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved? Under the apple tree I awakened you. There your mother was in labor with you; there she who bore you was in labor.
verses.textEnNkjv: Who is this coming up from the wilderness, Leaning upon her beloved? I awakened you under the apple tree. There your mother brought you forth; There she who bore you brought you forth. The Shulamite to Her Beloved
verses.textEnNlt: Who is this sweeping in from the desert, leaning on her lover? Young Woman I aroused you under the apple tree, where your mother gave you birth, where in great pain she delivered you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Who is this coming up from the wilderness, Leaning on her beloved?" The Bride "Beneath the apple tree I awakened you; There your mother went into labor with you, There she was in labor and gave birth to you.
verses.textEn: Who is this coming up from the wilderness leaning on her beloved? She Under the apple tree I roused you; there your mother conceived you, there she who was in labor gave you birth.

verses.textZh: 求你把我放在你心上如印记， 把我带在你臂上如戳印； 因为爱情像死亡一般的坚强； 嫉妒如阴间一般的坚稳； 它的烈焰是火的烈焰， 是非常猛烈的火焰。
verses.textZhCnvs: 求你把我放在你心上如印记， 把我带在你臂上如戳印； 因为爱情像死亡一般的坚强； 嫉妒如阴间一般的坚稳； 它的烈焰是火的烈焰， 是非常猛烈的火焰。
verses.textZhCuv: 求你将我放在你心上如印记， 带在你臂上如戳记。 因为爱情如死之坚强， 嫉恨如阴间之残忍； 所发的电光是火焰的电光， 是耶和华的烈焰。
verses.textEnNiv: Place me like a seal over your heart, like a seal on your arm; for love is as strong as death, its jealousy unyielding as the grave. It burns like blazing fire, like a mighty flame.
verses.textEnEsv: Set me as a seal upon your heart, as a seal upon your arm, for love is strong as death, jealousy is fierce as the grave. Its flashes are flashes of fire, the very flame of the Lord .
verses.textEnNkjv: Set me as a seal upon your heart, As a seal upon your arm; For love isas strong as death, Jealousy as cruel as the grave; Its flames are flames of fire, A most vehement flame.
verses.textEnNlt: Place me like a seal over your heart, like a seal on your arm. For love is as strong as death, its jealousy as enduring as the grave. Love flashes like fire, the brightest kind of flame.
verses.textEnNasb: "Put me like a seal over your heart, Like a seal on your arm. For love is as strong as death, Jealousy is as severe as Sheol; Its flames are flames of fire, The flame of the Lord.
verses.textEn: Place me like a seal over your heart, like a seal on your arm; for love is as strong as death, its jealousy unyielding as the grave. It burns like blazing fire, like a mighty flame.

verses.textZh: 爱情，众水不能熄灭， 洪流不能淹没； 如果有人拿自己家里所有的财产去换取爱情， 就必被藐视。
verses.textZhCnvs: 爱情，众水不能熄灭， 洪流不能淹没； 如果有人拿自己家里所有的财产去换取爱情， 就必被藐视。
verses.textZhCuv: 爱情，众水不能息灭， 大水也不能淹没。 若有人拿家中所有的财宝要换爱情， 就全被藐视。 〔新娘的兄弟〕
verses.textEnNiv: Many waters cannot quench love; rivers cannot sweep it away. If one were to give all the wealth of one’s house for love, it would be utterly scorned. Friends
verses.textEnEsv: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can floods drown it. If a man offered for love all the wealth of his house, he would be utterly despised. Others
verses.textEnNkjv: Many waters cannot quench love, Nor can the floods drown it. If a man would give for love All the wealth of his house, It would be utterly despised. The Shulamite’s Brothers
verses.textEnNlt: Many waters cannot quench love, nor can rivers drown it. If a man tried to buy love with all his wealth, his offer would be utterly scorned. The Young Woman’s Brothers
verses.textEnNasb: "Many waters cannot quench love, Nor will rivers flood over it; If a man were to give all the riches of his house for love, It would be utterly despised." The Chorus
verses.textEn: Many waters cannot quench love; rivers cannot sweep it away. If one were to give all the wealth of one’s house for love, it would be utterly scorned. Friends

verses.textZh: 我们有一个小妹妹， 她的两乳还未发育完全； 有人来提亲的时候， 我们当为她怎样办理呢？
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们有一个小妹妹， 她的两乳还未发育完全； 有人来提亲的时候， 我们当为她怎样办理呢？
verses.textZhCuv: 我们有一小妹； 她的两乳尚未长成， 人来提亲的日子， 我们当为她怎样办理？
verses.textEnNiv: We have a little sister, and her breasts are not yet grown. What shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for?
verses.textEnEsv: We have a little sister, and she has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister on the day when she is spoken for?
verses.textEnNkjv: We have a little sister, And she has no breasts. What shall we do for our sister In the day when she is spoken for?
verses.textEnNlt: We have a little sister too young to have breasts. What will we do for our sister if someone asks to marry her?
verses.textEnNasb: "We have a little sister, And she has no breasts; What shall we do for our sister On the day when she is spoken for?
verses.textEn: We have a little sister, and her breasts are not yet grown. What shall we do for our sister on the day she is spoken for?

verses.textZh: 她若是墙， 我们就要在她上面建造银塔； 她若是门， 我们就要用香柏木板围护她。
verses.textZhCnvs: 她若是墙， 我们就要在她上面建造银塔； 她若是门， 我们就要用香柏木板围护她。
verses.textZhCuv: 她若是墙， 我们要在其上建造银塔； 她若是门， 我们要用香柏木板围护她。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: If she is a wall, we will build towers of silver on her. If she is a door, we will enclose her with panels of cedar. She
verses.textEnEsv: If she is a wall, we will build on her a battlement of silver, but if she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar. She
verses.textEnNkjv: If she is a wall, We will build upon her A battlement of silver; And if she is a door, We will enclose her With boards of cedar. The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: If she is a virgin, like a wall, we will protect her with a silver tower. But if she is promiscuous, like a swinging door, we will block her door with a cedar bar. Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: "If she is a wall, We will build on her a battlement of silver; But if she is a door, We will barricade her with planks of cedar." The Bride
verses.textEn: If she is a wall, we will build towers of silver on her. If she is a door, we will enclose her with panels of cedar. She

verses.textZh: 我是墙，我的两乳像其上的塔； 我在他的眼中像寻得安乐的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我是墙，我的两乳像其上的塔； 我在他的眼中像寻得安乐的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我是墙； 我两乳像其上的楼。 那时，我在他眼中像得平安的人。 〔新郎〕
verses.textEnNiv: I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers. Thus I have become in his eyes like one bringing contentment.
verses.textEnEsv: I was a wall, and my breasts were like towers; then I was in his eyes as one who finds peace.
verses.textEnNkjv: I am a wall, And my breasts like towers; Then I became in his eyes As one who found peace.
verses.textEnNlt: I was a virgin, like a wall; now my breasts are like towers. When my lover looks at me, he is delighted with what he sees.
verses.textEnNasb: "I was a wall, and my breasts were like towers; Then I became in his eyes as one who finds peace.
verses.textEn: I am a wall, and my breasts are like towers. Thus I have become in his eyes like one bringing contentment.

verses.textZh: 所罗门在巴力．哈们有个葡萄园； 他把这葡萄园租给看守的人， 各人要为葡萄园所得的果子付一万一千四百克银子。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所罗门在巴力．哈们有个葡萄园； 他把这葡萄园租给看守的人， 各人要为葡萄园所得的果子付一万一千四百克银子。
verses.textZhCuv: 所罗门在巴力‧哈们有一葡萄园； 他将这葡萄园交给看守的人， 为其中的果子必交一千舍客勒银子。
verses.textEnNiv: Solomon had a vineyard in Baal Hamon; he let out his vineyard to tenants. Each was to bring for its fruit a thousand shekels of silver.
verses.textEnEsv: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; he let out the vineyard to keepers; each one was to bring for its fruit a thousand pieces of silver.
verses.textEnNkjv: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon; He leased the vineyard to keepers; Everyone was to bring for its fruit A thousand silver coins. (To Solomon)
verses.textEnNlt: Solomon has a vineyard at Baal-hamon, which he leases out to tenant farmers. Each of them pays a thousand pieces of silver for harvesting its fruit.
verses.textEnNasb: "Solomon had a vineyard at Baal-hamon; He entrusted the vineyard to caretakers. Each one was to bring a thousand shekels of silver for its fruit.
verses.textEn: Solomon had a vineyard in Baal Hamon; he let out his vineyard to tenants. Each was to bring for its fruit a thousand shekels of silver.

verses.textZh: 我自己的葡萄园却在我面前， 所罗门哪，一万一千四百克归给你， 二千二百八十克归给那些看守果子的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我自己的葡萄园却在我面前， 所罗门哪，一万一千四百克归给你， 二千二百八十克归给那些看守果子的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 我自己的葡萄园在我面前。 所罗门哪，一千舍客勒归你， 二百舍客勒归看守果子的人。
verses.textEnNiv: But my own vineyard is mine to give; the thousand shekels are for you, Solomon, and two hundred are for those who tend its fruit. He
verses.textEnEsv: My vineyard, my very own, is before me; you, O Solomon, may have the thousand, and the keepers of the fruit two hundred. He
verses.textEnNkjv: My own vineyard is before me. You, O Solomon, mayhave a thousand, And those who tend its fruit two hundred. The Beloved
verses.textEnNlt: But my vineyard is mine to give, and Solomon need not pay a thousand pieces of silver. But I will give two hundred pieces to those who care for its vines. Young Man
verses.textEnNasb: "My very own vineyard is at my disposal; The thousand shekels are for you, Solomon, And two hundred are for those who take care of its fruit." The Groom
verses.textEn: But my own vineyard is mine to give; the thousand shekels are for you, Solomon, and two hundred are for those who tend its fruit. He

verses.textZh: 你这住在园中的啊！ 我的同伴都在细听你的声音； 愿你使我也听见。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你这住在园中的啊！ 我的同伴都在细听你的声音； 愿你使我也听见。
verses.textZhCuv: 你这住在园中的， 同伴都要听你的声音， 求你使我也得听见。 〔新娘〕
verses.textEnNiv: You who dwell in the gardens with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice! She
verses.textEnEsv: O you who dwell in the gardens, with companions listening for your voice; let me hear it. She
verses.textEnNkjv: You who dwell in the gardens, The companions listen for your voice— Let me hear it! The Shulamite
verses.textEnNlt: O my darling, lingering in the gardens, your companions are fortunate to hear your voice. Let me hear it, too! Young Woman
verses.textEnNasb: "You who sit in the gardens: My companions are listening for your voice— Let me hear it!" The Bride
verses.textEn: You who dwell in the gardens with friends in attendance, let me hear your voice! She

verses.textZh: 我的良人哪！愿你快来， 像羚羊或小鹿， 在香草山上！
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的良人哪！愿你快来， 像羚羊或小鹿， 在香草山上！
verses.textZhCuv: 我的良人哪，求你快来！ 如羚羊或小鹿在香草山上。
verses.textEnNiv: Come away, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or like a young stag on the spice-laden mountains.
verses.textEnEsv: Make haste, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices.
verses.textEnNkjv: Make haste, my beloved, And be like a gazelle Or a young stag On the mountains of spices.
verses.textEnNlt: Come away, my love! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices.
verses.textEnNasb: " Hurry, my beloved, And be like a gazelle or a young stag On the mountains of balsam trees!"
verses.textEn: Come away, my beloved, and be like a gazelle or like a young stag on the spice-laden mountains.
